Delhi is one of India's most important pharmaceutical business hubs, although its strength is different from the big manufacturing states. The capital hosts headquarters, marketing offices, importers and distributors, while many of the factories that supply them sit in neighbouring Haryana, Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand and Rajasthan.

This guide profiles 14 pharma companies with a registered or operating base in Delhi, from listed names such as Jagsonpal and Brawn Biotech to the Indian arm of MSD, API maker Coral Drugs and younger consumer healthcare brands. Every profile below is based on fresh research from company websites, MCA-derived registries and reputable industry sources.

Quick answer

  • Oldest roots: Walter Bushnell, part of the Martin & Harris group, which has been in pharmaceuticals in Delhi since 1924.
  • Listed companies: Jagsonpal Pharmaceuticals (BSE and NSE) and Brawn Biotech (BSE).
  • Biggest global name: MSD Pharmaceuticals, the Indian arm of Merck Sharp & Dohme, registered at Nehru Place.
  • API specialist: Coral Drugs, a Connaught Place headquartered maker of steroid and hormone APIs.
  • Services, not products: PFC Pharma Focus India is a clinical research organisation running trial management from Jasola.
  • Main clusters: Okhla for established pharma offices and units, Bawana and Narela for smaller manufacturing and packaging units.

The Delhi pharma sector at a glance

Delhi's pharmaceutical map is shaped by its industrial estates. The Okhla Industrial Area, built up across Phases I to III, is the city's historic pharma district and still hosts registered offices, export-oriented formulation units and packaging businesses. Further north, the DSIIDC estate at Bawana, one of Delhi's largest industrial areas, houses smaller pharma, ayurvedic, nutraceutical and packaging units, with Narela and Patparganj also hosting medicine-related manufacturing.

What Delhi offers that factory towns cannot is proximity. The headquarters of the Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO), the national drug regulator, are in the capital, and the city's airport, rail links and wholesale markets make it a natural distribution base for northern India. That is why so many companies keep their head office, sales and regulatory teams in Delhi even when production happens in other states.

  • Okhla (Phases I to III): the longest-established pharma cluster, mixing offices, formulation units and exporters.
  • Bawana and Narela: DSIIDC estates with SME pharma, ayurvedic, nutraceutical and packaging units.
  • Corporate pockets: Connaught Place, Nehru Place, Jasola and Saket host head offices of API makers, multinationals, CROs and startups.
  • Neighbouring supply base: plants in Faridabad, Gurugram, Baddi, Rudrapur and Neemrana commonly supply Delhi-based brands.

Comparison table: the 14 companies

Company profiles in detail

1. Bio Nucleus Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd.

Bio Nucleus is one of the smaller and quieter names on this list, and public information about it is limited. Registry records show a private limited company incorporated in January 2015 with its registered office at Mahavir Enclave in south-west Delhi, and it maintains an official website at bionucleuspharma.com.

Because the company publishes little verifiable detail about its products or scale, anyone planning to trade with it should confirm its current licences and product range directly before placing an order.

  • Registered office: D-2/144, Mahavir Enclave, New Delhi 110045
  • Incorporated: 19 January 2015 (CIN U33110DL2015PTC275677)
  • Directors: Supriya Verma and Kumar Prashant
  • Public information: Limited; verify licences and range directly with the company

2. Brawn Biotech Limited

Brawn Biotech is a BSE-listed company that trades and wholesales pharmaceutical formulations rather than running large factories of its own. It began in November 1985 as Brawn Pharmaceuticals Limited and took its present name in November 2010, reflecting a wider healthcare and biotechnology focus.

From its registered office in Lajpat Nagar, the company deals in formulations across 12 segments, including antibacterials, cardiovascular and antidiabetic medicines, analgesics, gastrointestinal products, skin care and nutritionals. Its listed status means its filings and results are publicly available, which makes due diligence straightforward for trade partners.

  • Listed: BSE, scrip code 530207
  • Founded: November 1985, as Brawn Pharmaceuticals Limited
  • Registered office: C-64, Lajpat Nagar-I, New Delhi 110024
  • Business: Trading and wholesale of formulations across 12 therapy segments

3. Coral Drugs Pvt. Limited

Coral Drugs is an API (active pharmaceutical ingredient) manufacturer headquartered on Barakhamba Road in Connaught Place. The company says its operations began in 1996, and it has grown into a vertically integrated, cGMP-certified supplier with six manufacturing blocks, more than 50 KL of capacity, over 200 employees and more than 250 customers worldwide.

Its specialism is steroids and hormones, with particular expertise in inhalation molecules and particle engineering. The product list includes corticosteroid APIs such as budesonide and fluticasone propionate, alongside hormone and antineoplastic ingredients, supported by more than 50 drug master file submissions globally.

  • Headquarters: 1001 Akash Deep Building, 26-A Barakhamba Road, Connaught Place, New Delhi 110001
  • Operating since: 1996, per the company's official website
  • Known for: Steroid, hormone and inhalation APIs; particle sizing expertise
  • Scale (company-stated): 6 manufacturing blocks, 50 KL+ capacity, 250+ global customers

4. IBERIA SKINBRANDS INDIA PVT. LTD.

Iberia Skinbrands India is the Delhi-based importer and marketer behind a portfolio of European dermocosmetic brands sold in Indian pharmacies and online stores. Its importer address is in Sector 8, Dwarka, and the brands it handles include the Actium Plus range.

Product labels show the range is manufactured by Iberia Skin Brands Sp. z o.o. in Warsaw, Poland, with Spain listed as the country of origin. The company therefore sits on the distribution side of the industry: it brings European skincare brands into India rather than manufacturing medicines itself.

  • Based in: Sector 8, Dwarka, New Delhi 110077
  • Business: Import and marketing of European dermocosmetic brands
  • Example brand: Actium Plus
  • Manufacturing: By Iberia Skin Brands Sp. z o.o., Poland; country of origin Spain

5. Jagsonpal Pharmaceuticals Ltd.

Jagsonpal is one of Delhi's oldest surviving pharma businesses. It was founded in 1964 by Jagmohan S. Kochhar, who began with a pharmacy in Delhi, and the company was incorporated in its present form on 17 August 1978. It is listed on both the BSE and the NSE, with its registered office in the Okhla Industrial Area.

The company concentrates on gynaecology, where rating agency ICRA describes it as a leader in the progesterone segment, and on orthopaedics. Well-known brands include Indocap (indomethacin), the antioxidant Lycored, Metadec and the progesterone brand Maintane, and the company is now a subsidiary of Aresko Progressive Private Limited.

  • Founded: 1964 by Jagmohan S. Kochhar; incorporated 17 August 1978
  • Listed: BSE and NSE
  • Registered office: Okhla Industrial Area, New Delhi
  • Focus areas: Gynaecology and orthopaedics
  • Key brands: Indocap, Lycored, Metadec, Maintane, Divatrone

6. M S D Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd.

MSD Pharmaceuticals is the Indian arm of Merck Sharp & Dohme, the global research-intensive biopharmaceutical group known as Merck & Co. in the United States and Canada. The Indian company, incorporated on 3 December 2004 as a subsidiary of Merck Sharp & Dohme B.V., keeps its registered office at Eros Corporate Tower in Nehru Place.

MSD markets innovative medicines and vaccines in India. Products associated with the company in Indian drug references include the cancer immunotherapy Keytruda (pembrolizumab) and the HPV vaccine Gardasil 9, alongside a wider portfolio in diabetes, infectious diseases and hospital care.

  • Parent: Merck Sharp & Dohme B.V. (Merck & Co. group)
  • Incorporated: 3 December 2004 (CIN U24230DL2004PTC164459)
  • Registered office: 1544, Level 15, Eros Corporate Tower, Nehru Place, New Delhi 110019
  • Known for: Keytruda, Gardasil 9 and other innovative medicines and vaccines

7. Maxmed Lifesciences Pvt. Ltd.

Maxmed Life Sciences Private Limited, incorporated on 14 June 2004 and earlier known as KK Maxmed Private Limited, is a Delhi formulations company run from Vikaspuri in west Delhi. Its production unit is at Rudrapur in Uttarakhand, a common pattern for Delhi brands that manufacture in excise-friendly neighbouring states.

The company markets its own brands, including the antibiotic Maxime (cefuroxime), Cefomed, M-Penem and Odeof, across solid and liquid dosage forms. It also operates a PCD franchise model, appointing district-level partners to sell its range, which makes it a familiar name among small pharma distributors.

  • Incorporated: 14 June 2004 (CIN U24232DL2004PTC126912), formerly KK Maxmed Pvt. Ltd.
  • Delhi office: B-10 (Basement), Shankar Garden, Vikaspuri, New Delhi 110018
  • Manufacturing unit: Rudrapur, Uttarakhand
  • Key brands: Maxime, Cefomed, M-Penem, Odeof, Diace-GM
  • Business model: Own brands plus PCD franchise marketing

8. Nestor Pharmaceuticals Limited, India

Nestor Pharmaceuticals traces its family business roots to 1917 and took its present corporate form on 13 October 1975. Its registered office is in the Okhla Industrial Area, Phase II, and its manufacturing plants are at Faridabad in Haryana and in Goa, from where it supplies markets across India and abroad.

The company makes formulations in almost every dosage form, including tablets, capsules, injectables, syrups, ointments, dry powders and eye and ear drops, and holds around 200 trademarks. Rating agency Infomerics reported total income of ₹204.92 crore for the company in FY24.

  • Incorporated: 13 October 1975 (CIN U24231DL1975PLC007959); family business roots to 1917
  • Registered office: A-106, DDA Shed, Okhla Industrial Area Phase-II, New Delhi 110020
  • Plants: Faridabad (Haryana) and Goa
  • Range: Tablets, capsules, injectables, syrups, ointments, dry powders, eye and ear drops
  • Reported income: ₹204.92 crore total income in FY24 (Infomerics)

9. PFC Pharma Private Limited

The company listed here is registered as PFC Pharma Focus India Private Limited, and it is the services entry on this list: a contract research organisation (CRO) rather than a medicine manufacturer. Incorporated on 23 June 2008 with its registered office at Jasola in south Delhi, it is a subsidiary of Excel Life Sciences Private Limited.

PFC India grew out of a 2009 partnership between Switzerland-based PFC Pharma Focus and Excel Life Sciences to support clinical trials in India. Its work covers study planning, clinical monitoring, audit and data management for pharmaceutical and biotechnology sponsors running trials in the country.

  • Registered name: PFC Pharma Focus India Private Limited
  • Incorporated: 23 June 2008 (CIN U24232DL2008PTC179947)
  • Registered office: Plot 121, Basement, Pocket-1, Jasola, New Delhi 110025
  • Parent: Excel Life Sciences Private Limited
  • Services: Clinical trial management, monitoring, audit and data management

10. Ronyd Healthcare Private Limited

Ronyd Healthcare, incorporated on 8 April 2002, is a marketing-led pharmaceutical company headquartered in Delhi, with its registered office at Khirki Village in Malviya Nagar and an office in Sector 33, Gurugram. Directors Goldie Sethi and Sheena Sethi lead the business.

The company sells products across more than 20 therapeutic areas, manufactured for it in WHO-GMP approved units, and says its field force of over 250 marketing representatives covers markets across India. It is a typical example of the Delhi model: brand ownership, marketing and distribution in the capital, with production contracted to specialist plants.

  • Incorporated: 8 April 2002 (CIN U51397DL2002PTC114890)
  • Registered office: 179-D, Khirki Village, Press Enclave Road, Malviya Nagar, New Delhi 110017
  • Directors: Goldie Sethi and Sheena Sethi
  • Coverage: 20+ therapeutic areas; 250+ field representatives (company-stated)
  • Manufacturing: Through WHO-GMP approved third-party units

11. Sesderma India Private Limited

Sesderma India is the Indian subsidiary of Sesderma, the dermocosmetics group founded in Valencia, Spain, in 1989 by dermatologist Dr Gabriel Serrano. The Indian company was incorporated on 31 January 2013 and is registered at Bhagirath Palace in Chandni Chowk, in the heart of old Delhi's wholesale markets.

Registered with the MCA for wholesale trading of cosmetic articles, the company sells Sesderma's Spanish-made skincare ranges in India, including the C-Vit antioxidant line. On retail packs, Iberia Skinbrands appears as the marketer and importer partner, which is why the two Delhi companies are often seen together.

  • Incorporated: 31 January 2013 (CIN U51909DL2013FTC247712)
  • Parent brand: Sesderma, founded 1989 in Valencia, Spain, by Dr Gabriel Serrano
  • Registered office: Property No. 1704, Bhagirath Palace, Chandni Chowk, New Delhi 110006
  • Known for: Dermocosmetics such as the C-Vit range, manufactured in Spain

12. STANFORD LABORATORIES PVT. LTD.

Stanford Laboratories is a formulations manufacturer that has been in business since 1996 and describes its roots as being in Delhi, with its administrative and marketing office in Gurugram in Delhi NCR. It is a subsidiary of La Renon Healthcare Private Limited.

The company is a WHO-GMP certified specialist in oral solid dosage forms, including sustained-release, delayed-release, enteric-coated and film-coated tablets, capsules, dry syrups and liquid orals. Production runs from its plant at Mehatpur in Una district, Himachal Pradesh, and a facility at Ghiloth, Neemrana, in Rajasthan.

  • In business since: 1996 (company profiles)
  • Certification: WHO-GMP certified manufacturing
  • Plants: Mehatpur, Una (Himachal Pradesh) and Ghiloth, Neemrana (Rajasthan)
  • Specialism: Modified-release tablets, capsules, dry syrups and liquid orals
  • Parent: Subsidiary of La Renon Healthcare Pvt. Ltd.

13. Vytals Wellbeing India Private Limited

Vytals is the youngest company on this list, incorporated on 12 August 2021 with its registered office at Saket in south Delhi and a corporate office in Gurugram. Directors Ruchika Bhartia and Saket Bhartia lead the business, which operates under the vytals brand.

It is a consumer healthcare company rather than a prescription-drug maker. Its portfolio covers OTC products, nutraceuticals and dietary supplements aimed at ageing, lifestyle and nutrition needs, sold directly to consumers through online and omnichannel routes.

  • Incorporated: 12 August 2021 (CIN U24290DL2021PTC385080)
  • Registered office: Regus Rectangle, D-4 Saket District Centre, New Delhi 110017
  • Directors: Ruchika Bhartia and Saket Bhartia
  • Focus: OTC pharma, nutraceuticals and dietary supplements, sold D2C

14. Walter Bushnell

Walter Bushnell is part of the Martin & Harris group, a Delhi house that has been in pharmaceuticals since 1924, when Martin & Harris Private Limited was incorporated in the city. Few Indian pharma brands can claim a longer continuous history in the capital.

The brand is best known for Drotin, its drotaverine antispasmodic, launched in 1997 and protected by a trademark dating to February 1997, as recorded in a Delhi High Court judgment involving the company. Walter Bushnell continues to market its formulations through its official website, walterbushnell.com.

  • Group: Martin & Harris, in pharmaceuticals in Delhi since 1924
  • Best-known brand: Drotin (drotaverine), launched 1997
  • Website: walterbushnell.com

How to choose and verify a Delhi pharma supplier

Delhi's mix of manufacturers, marketing companies and traders makes verification essential before you place an order or sign a franchise agreement. A genuine company will share its documents openly, and most checks below take only a few minutes online.

  • Check the MCA record: confirm the company name, CIN, status and registered office on an MCA-derived registry before paying any advance.
  • Ask for the drug licence: manufacturers and wholesalers must hold valid licences under the Drugs and Cosmetics Act for the premises they trade from.
  • Verify certifications directly: for WHO-GMP or cGMP claims, ask for the certificate and cross-check the issuing authority and plant address.
  • Confirm where production happens: many Delhi brands manufacture in other states; the plant address on the product label should match what you were told.
  • Start small: place a trial order, check batch quality, packaging and expiry handling, and only then scale up or sign exclusivity.

Frequently asked questions

Which parts of Delhi have the most pharma companies?

Okhla is the best-known cluster, with offices and units across its three phases. Smaller manufacturing and packaging units are concentrated in the DSIIDC estates at Bawana and Narela, while corporate offices sit in Connaught Place, Nehru Place, Jasola and Saket.

Is Delhi mainly a manufacturing or a trading hub for pharma?

Mainly a headquarters, marketing and distribution hub. Many Delhi companies own brands and sales networks in the capital but manufacture in Haryana, Himachal Pradesh, Uttarakhand or Rajasthan, as Nestor, Maxmed and Stanford do.

Which Delhi pharma companies are listed on stock exchanges?

Jagsonpal Pharmaceuticals is listed on both the BSE and the NSE. Brawn Biotech is listed on the BSE. Their annual reports and shareholding details are public, which makes them the easiest companies on this list to research in depth.

Do Delhi pharma companies offer PCD franchises?

Yes. Marketing-led companies such as Maxmed Lifesciences openly run PCD franchise models, and several other Delhi brands appoint district distributors. Always verify the company's licences and product registrations before paying a deposit.

How can I check whether a Delhi pharma company is genuine?

Look up its CIN and status in MCA records, confirm its GST registration, ask for its drug licence and manufacturing or loan-licence documents, and match the plant address on product labels with the addresses the company gives you.

What is the difference between MSD Pharmaceuticals and Merck in India?

They are the same group. MSD is the name used by Merck & Co. outside the United States and Canada, and MSD Pharmaceuticals Private Limited, registered at Nehru Place in New Delhi, is its Indian subsidiary.

Gurugram, in Haryana's corner of Delhi NCR, hosts one of northern India's densest pharmaceutical clusters. This guide profiles 72 pharma companies in Gurugram, from Eli Lilly's India headquarters and Tata 1mg to single-office franchise marketers in the city's industrial estates.

Every profile below was researched afresh in November 2026 from official company websites, MCA-derived registries and trade directories. Where a company's own claims could not be independently verified, they are labelled as company statements. Where public information is genuinely scarce, the profile says so instead of guessing.

Quick answer

  • 72 companies are profiled below, in one list, from multinationals to small local marketers.
  • The largest Gurugram operations include Eli Lilly India, Fresenius Kabi Oncology, Stryker, Syneos Health, Bio-Rad India and Tata 1mg.
  • Standout specialists: Sentiss Pharma and Jawa Pharmaceuticals in eye care, Getwell Oncology in cancer medicines, and Indovax in poultry vaccines.
  • Offices cluster in Udyog Vihar, Sector 32 and along Sohna Road; most factories sit at IMT Manesar and in the Bawal industrial belt.
  • Many smaller firms work on PCD franchise or third-party manufacturing models, so verify licences before signing any agreement.

The Gurugram pharma sector at a glance

Gurugram's pharma industry is led by offices rather than factories. Indian headquarters, multinational India offices and specialist service firms cluster in Udyog Vihar, the Sector 32 institutional area, Cyber City and the office towers along Golf Course Road and Sohna Road.

Manufacturing sits mostly outside the office districts. IMT Manesar, on NH-48 south-west of the city, and the Bawal industrial belt in Rewari district further south host the larger plants, while estates such as Pace City and the IDC area hold smaller units inside Gurugram. Industry portal PharmaAdda estimates Haryana's pharmaceutical exports at roughly US$2 billion a year.

  • Headquarters cluster: Eli Lilly India, Fresenius Kabi Oncology, Bio-Rad India and Stryker all run major offices from Gurugram.
  • Manufacturing belt: IMT Manesar and Bawal carry the heavy plants; several listed companies also run units in Pace City, Sector 37 and the IDC area.
  • Services strength: CROs and service firms such as Syneos Health, medONE, DDReg Pharma, Mediception Science and Prescient Healthcare Group employ large specialist teams here.
  • Distribution and digital: Aryan Wellness runs large-scale medicine distribution and cold chain, while Tata 1mg built its e-pharmacy and diagnostics platform from Gurugram.
  • Small-company base: dozens of PCD franchise and marketing companies operate from small offices in Sushant Lok, Laxmi Bazar, Vijay Park and Sohna Road towers.

Quick comparison — pharma companies in Gurugram

The table uses only facts verified during research for this guide. Companies marked “limited public information” appear in directories or registries without a verifiable public profile of their products.

Detailed profiles

1. A.S. Pharmaceuticals

A.S. Pharmaceuticals is a dermatology-focused marketing company that works mainly through the PCD franchise route. From its corporate office in Pace City-2, Sector 37, it supplies skin-care formulations to franchise partners who sell them in their own territories.

The range is wide for a specialist: creams, lotions, ointments and gels sit alongside shampoos, soaps, face washes and serums, plus dermatology tablets and capsules. The company says it has operated since 1998 and offers monopoly rights to franchise partners.

Key facts

  • Corporate office: Block B-2, Plot 696, Pace City-2, Sector 37, Gurugram
  • Focus: dermatology formulations and skin-care products
  • Business model: PCD pharma franchise with monopoly territory rights
  • Operating since 1998, as stated in directory records

2. Adirex Pharmaceuticals Private Limited

Adirex Pharmaceuticals is a small Gurugram formulation company incorporated in October 2015. Its registered base is in Sushant Lok Phase I, Sector 43, a residential-commercial pocket that hosts many small pharma marketing offices.

Public information about its product range is limited. Directory listings describe Adirex as a manufacturer of allopathic medicines, and registry records name Rekha Dandapat and Debkumar Dandapat as its directors.

Key facts

  • Incorporated: 12 October 2015
  • CIN: U74900HR2015PTC056936
  • Registered address: 77A/5, Sushant Lok Phase I, Sector 43, Gurugram
  • Directors: Rekha Dandapat and Debkumar Dandapat

3. Agex Laboratories Pvt. Ltd.

Agex Laboratories markets a broad range of pharmaceutical formulations from Wazirabad in Sector 52, Gurugram. Its best-known products include the AGEX-SL range of ceftriaxone-combination injectables, sold through its official website and trade channels.

The company's own brochure claims a range of more than 200 products and ISO 9001:2015 and WHO-GMP aligned manufacturing. Those figures are company statements, so buyers should ask for current certificates before relying on them.

Key facts

  • Base: G-8, Wazirabad, Sector 52, Gurugram
  • Known product line: AGEX-SL ceftriaxone-combination injectables
  • Company-stated range: 200+ formulation products
  • Company-stated credentials: ISO 9001:2015 and WHO-GMP/cGMP

4. Aple Gurgaon

Aple Gurgaon appears in map and directory listings in the South City Road area of Gurugram, where it is categorised as a public or government service rather than a medicine manufacturer.

No official website, registry profile or product information could be verified for this name during research. Treat it as a listing-only entry and confirm its identity and line of business directly before any dealing.

Key facts

  • Appears in map listings near South City Road, Gurugram
  • Listing category: public/government service
  • Limited public information: no verified website or product range found

5. Aryan Wellness Pvt. Ltd.

Aryan Wellness is a pharmaceutical distribution company, founded in 1993 as Aryan Medicare by Rajesh Kumar Arya and Dinesh Kumar Arya. It stocks and supplies medicines from Indian and multinational companies to pharmacies, hospitals and institutions.

The company states that it handles more than 16,000 products from over 300 manufacturers and serves over 5,000 customers from 60,000 sq ft of facilities. In May 2019 it launched a dedicated cold-chain division, “2 to 8 Degree by Aryan Wellness”, for temperature-sensitive medicines.

Key facts

  • Founded: 1993, as Aryan Medicare
  • Founders: Rajesh Kumar Arya and Dinesh Kumar Arya
  • Company-stated scale: 16,000+ products, 300+ manufacturers, 5,000+ customers
  • Cold-chain division launched May 2019: 2 to 8 Degree by Aryan Wellness

6. Avanscure Lifesciences Pvt Ltd.

Avanscure Lifesciences, established in 2012, works in global sourcing and international marketing of pharmaceutical raw materials and finished products. It operates from Plot 667, Udyog Vihar Phase V, Gurugram.

Trade directories describe it as an exporter, importer and distributor of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), formulations, biological products, chemicals and intermediates. A second business address is listed at Super Mart Complex-I in DLF Phase IV.

Key facts

  • Established: 2012
  • Office: Plot 667, Udyog Vihar Phase V, Gurugram
  • Trade: APIs, formulations, biologicals, chemicals and intermediates
  • Director: Gagan Jot Singh

7. Bio-Rad Laboratories India Pvt. Ltd.

Bio-Rad Laboratories India is the Indian arm of Bio-Rad Laboratories, the life-science and diagnostics company founded in 1952 and headquartered in Hercules, California. The Indian entity was incorporated in April 1996.

Its registered office is at Emaar Digital Greens in Sector 61, Gurugram, with another Gurugram address at Bio-Rad House in Udyog Vihar Phase IV. The company sells research instruments, reagents and clinical diagnostic systems in India, including Droplet Digital PCR technology.

Key facts

  • Indian entity incorporated: 25 April 1996
  • Registered office: Emaar Digital Greens, Sector 61, Gurugram
  • Parent: Bio-Rad Laboratories, founded 1952, Hercules, California, USA
  • Fields: life-science research products and clinical diagnostics

8. BISISTA PHARMA PVT. LTD.

BISISTA Pharma is a young Haryana company incorporated in January 2021, working in drug formulation and development. Its registered office is recorded in Faridabad, and it is registered as a micro enterprise under Udyam.

Beyond registry and directory records, little public information about its products or operations is available. This profile is therefore limited to verified registry facts.

Key facts

  • Incorporated: 14 January 2021
  • CIN: U24290HR2021PTC092216
  • Segment: drug formulation and development
  • Limited public information: registry and directory records only

9. BKRS Pharma Pvt. Ltd.

BKRS Pharma is a formulations company incorporated in May 2012, based at the Spazedge Commercial Complex on Sohna Road. It markets branded and generic medicines, with directors Sumeer Koul and Beenu Koul named in registry records.

Its export focus is Russia and the CIS, where it already sells, and its IPHEX exhibitor profile says registrations are in progress for South East Asia, Africa and Latin America.

Key facts

  • Incorporated: 17 May 2012
  • CIN: U24230HR2012PTC045971
  • Office: Unit 421, Tower B, Spazedge Commercial Complex, Sector 47, Gurugram
  • Exports: Russia and CIS; registrations under way in other regions

10. BULAT Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.

BULAT Pharmaceutical was incorporated in August 2017 and is classed in registry records as a foreign-subsidiary company. Its registered office is in Dwarka, New Delhi.

Filings visible in MCA-derived directories are several years old, and no current product or operations information could be verified. This profile is limited to registry facts, and the company's present status should be checked directly before any dealing.

Key facts

  • Incorporated: 23 August 2017
  • CIN: U24304DL2017FTC322559
  • Registered office: Dwarka, New Delhi
  • Limited public information: no current operations profile found

11. Butame Pharma

Butame Pharma appears in map and directory listings at 944-C, Sushant Lok Phase I, Gurugram, where it is categorised as a pharmaceutical company.

No official website, registry profile or product information could be verified for this name during research. This is a listing-only profile; confirm the company's identity, licences and range directly before any dealing.

Key facts

  • Listing address: 944-C, Sushant Lok Phase I, Gurugram
  • Listing category: pharmaceutical company
  • Limited public information: no verified website or product range found

12. Cause & Cure

Cause & Cure is a speciality pharmaceutical company focused on two areas: gastroenterology and dermatology. Its office is at Buildings 17 and 18, Vijay Park, Pratap Nagar, in Sector 8, Gurugram.

The company presents its range through its official website, cncpl.in. Beyond its two speciality areas and Gurugram base, detailed public information about its products and scale is limited.

Key facts

  • Office: Buildings 17 & 18, Vijay Park, Pratap Nagar, Sector 8, Gurugram
  • Focus areas: gastroenterology and dermatology
  • Official website: cncpl.in

13. Century Life Science (P) Ltd

Century Life Science says it has worked in the pharmaceutical industry since 2003. Its office stands opposite Plot 52 in Udyog Vihar Phase VI, Sector 37, Gurugram.

The company states that it markets more than 85 formulations across 11 specialities, including ENT, dermatology, orthopaedics, gastroenterology, gynaecology, diabetology, cardiology and neurology. It grows through a franchise and distribution model that offers partners monopoly territory rights.

Key facts

  • In the pharmaceutical industry since 2003 (company statement)
  • Office: opposite Plot 52, Udyog Vihar Phase VI, Sector 37, Gurugram
  • Company-stated range: 85+ formulations across 11 specialities
  • Model: franchise and distribution with monopoly rights

14. Curezip Pharma Pvt. Ltd.

Curezip is a Gurugram health-technology company working on affordable medicines. Startup tracker Inc42 profiled Curezip Pharmaceuticals as founded in 2020 and based in Gurugram.

Directory listings place Curezip Pharma at House No. 388/22, Gandhi Nagar, Gurgaon. Detailed public information about its current products and services is limited, so this profile stays brief.

Key facts

  • Founded: 2020 (per Inc42 startup profile)
  • Base: Gurugram, Haryana
  • Focus: affordable medicines through a health-tech model
  • Directory address: H. No. 388/22, Gandhi Nagar, Gurgaon

15. DDReg Pharma Pvt. Ltd.

DDReg Pharma is a regulatory-services company founded in 2009 by Neeraj Pant. It is headquartered at Spaze i-Tech Park on Sohna Road, Gurugram, with a US entity in Delaware and delivery teams in Mumbai, Hyderabad and Gurugram.

Its services cover regulatory affairs, pharmacovigilance, quality and GMP consulting, medical writing, labelling and intellectual property. DDReg also offers RegIntel, an AI-based regulatory-intelligence platform, and won two awards at the ET Health Conclave 2025 in Gurgaon.

Key facts

  • Founded: 2009; founder Neeraj Pant
  • Head office: Spaze i-Tech Park, Sector 49, Sohna Road, Gurugram
  • Services: regulatory affairs, pharmacovigilance, GMP, medical writing, IPR

How to choose and verify a pharma company in Gurugram

Gurugram mixes genuine manufacturers, marketing companies that outsource production, distributors and service firms. Two companies with similar-looking offices can have very different licences and capabilities, so a short verification routine matters before you sign a franchise, supply or services agreement.

  • Check the drug licence: manufacturing and wholesale trade in Haryana are licensed by the state Food and Drugs Administration. Ask for the licence number and confirm it matches the premises.
  • Verify the company on the MCA registry: the CIN, incorporation date, directors and active status in each profile above came from MCA-derived records, and you can repeat that check free of charge.
  • Separate the office from the factory: many Gurugram addresses are marketing offices. Ask where products are actually manufactured and whose name appears on the manufacturing licence.
  • Treat certification claims carefully: ISO and WHO-GMP claims in brochures and directories are company statements until you see a current certificate issued to that company and site.
  • For exporters, ask for product registrations in the destination country rather than relying on claims of presence in a region.

Frequently asked questions

Which are the biggest pharma companies in Gurugram?

There is no single official ranking. By global scale, the largest operations are Eli Lilly India, Stryker, Syneos Health, Bio-Rad India and Fresenius Kabi Oncology, all with major Gurugram offices. Tata 1mg is headquartered here, and Sentiss Pharma is among the largest Indian specialists based in the city.

Where are pharma factories near Gurugram located?

Most larger plants sit outside the office districts, at IMT Manesar on NH-48 and in the Bawal industrial belt in Rewari district. Smaller units operate inside Gurugram in estates such as Pace City, Sector 37 and the IDC area on Mehrauli Road. Many Gurugram offices are marketing or headquarters sites whose products are made by third-party plants elsewhere.

Do Gurugram pharma companies offer PCD franchise arrangements?

Yes. PCD and franchise marketing is a common model among the city's smaller companies. A.S. Pharmaceuticals, Membrane Pharma and Century Life Science are among the firms in this list that describe franchise offers with territory rights. Always verify the drug licence and the actual manufacturing source before paying any deposit.

How can I verify a Gurugram pharma company before dealing with it?

Start with the MCA registry to confirm the CIN, directors and active status. Then check the Haryana FDA drug licence for the premises, match the address against the company's official website, and ask for current WHO-GMP or ISO certificates where quality claims matter. Profiles in this guide marked “limited public information” need extra care.

Which Gurugram companies specialise in eye care?

Sentiss Pharma is the city's best-known ophthalmology specialist, with ENT and inhalation products alongside. Jawa Pharmaceuticals has made ophthalmic products since 1971, and Guerison entered India in 2022 with a 25-product eye-care range.

Is Tata 1mg based in Gurugram?

Yes. The company began in April 2015 as 1mg, spun out of HealthkartPlus, and is headquartered in Gurugram. Tata Digital took a majority stake in 2021, and the platform now covers online medicine sales, diagnostic tests and doctor consultations.

Pune is one of India's most complete pharmaceutical addresses. The city is home to the world's largest vaccine maker, a listed formulations major in Hinjewadi, global groups running plants in the wider district, and hundreds of smaller formulation, packaging and services firms in between. This guide profiles 98 of them in one place.

Every profile below was refreshed in November 2026 from company websites, corporate registries and reputable reporting. Where a company's public record is thin, the profile says so plainly instead of filling the gap with guesses. Logos and images are the ones already published with each listing, kept with the same company.

Quick answer — Pune pharma at a glance

  • Serum Institute of India, at Hadapsar, is the world's largest vaccine manufacturer by doses and supplies more than 170 countries.
  • Emcure Pharmaceuticals, headquartered in Hinjewadi, is Pune's best-known listed formulations company: founded in 1981 and listed in 2024.
  • Fresenius Kabi India runs its plant at Ranjangaon in Pune district, covering infusion therapy and clinical nutrition.
  • SAVA Healthcare and Cian Healthcare anchor the city's strong mid-size formulations tier.
  • Bilcare built its name in pharmaceutical packaging from Pune, not in medicines themselves.
  • Animal health is a genuine Pune segment too, through HIPRA India, SAVA's animal-health work and Vivaldis.
  • Most of the 98 companies here are small formulation, marketing or distribution firms, so verify licences before you buy from or partner with any of them.

Why Pune became a pharma hub

Pune's pharma map follows its industrial map. Hinjewadi, better known for information technology, also hosts biotech and research units in its IT-BT Park, including Emcure's headquarters. Pimpri-Chinchwad and Bhosari carry the older formulation and engineering base, while Chakan and Ranjangaon, in the wider district, host larger plants such as Fresenius Kabi's.

  • Vaccine heritage: Serum Institute has made Pune a global vaccine address since 1966, and public-sector Hindustan Antibiotics at Pimpri dates back to 1954.
  • Research anchors: the National Chemical Laboratory and a deep university base supply scientists to local research centres.
  • Industrial estates: MIDC areas at Bhosari, Hinjewadi, Chakan and Ranjangaon give firms serviced land and supplier networks.
  • Market access: Pune sits inside Maharashtra's pharma belt, a few hours from Mumbai's ports, finance and regulators.

The result is a layered industry: a handful of nationally known names, a solid middle tier of formulation makers and specialists such as probiotics and packaging firms, and a long tail of small marketing and distribution companies. This guide covers all three layers.

Quick comparison — the researched names

The table covers the companies with the deepest verified public records. All 98 companies, including the many smaller firms, are profiled in the next section.

The profiles follow the guide's established order. Companies with a solid public record carry key-facts bullets. Smaller firms with limited public information carry short profiles, stated as such, until more can be verified.

Abbott's Indian business is one of the country's oldest healthcare operations, with roots in India going back to 1910. Its listed Indian arm, Abbott India Limited, is headquartered in Mumbai and markets more than 400 pharmaceutical brands alongside nutrition products, diagnostics and medical devices. Pune appears in this guide as one of its many Indian market bases.

How to choose or verify a Pune pharma company

A directory listing is a starting point, not a guarantee. Before buying from, supplying to or joining any company in this guide, run a few basic checks. They take minutes and prevent most bad surprises.

  • Check the manufacturing or wholesale drug licence with the Maharashtra FDA, which publishes licence records online.
  • Confirm the legal entity in MCA records: incorporation status, registered address and active status should match what the company tells you.
  • For manufacturers, ask which site will make your product and whether that site holds the approvals your market needs, such as WHO-GMP or export certifications.
  • For distributors and marketing firms, confirm GST registration and authorised signatory details before paying any advance.
  • Treat directory ratings and unsourced claims with caution, and prefer facts the company publishes itself.

If a company's profile here is short, that reflects its public footprint, not a judgement on its quality. Small firms can be excellent partners; they simply publish less about themselves.

Frequently asked questions

Which is the biggest pharma company in Pune?

By output, Serum Institute of India. It is the world's largest vaccine manufacturer by doses, producing around 1.9 billion doses a year from its Hadapsar and Manjari campuses in Pune and supplying more than 170 countries.

Which parts of Pune have the most pharma companies?

Hinjewadi for biotech, research and head offices; Pimpri-Chinchwad and Bhosari for formulation plants; and Chakan and Ranjangaon in Pune district for larger manufacturing sites. Many marketing and distribution firms sit in city neighbourhoods such as Kothrud, Baner and Viman Nagar.

Are all 98 companies in this guide manufacturers?

No. Most are formulation makers or marketing companies, but the list also includes a packaging specialist (Bilcare), animal-health firms, a research centre, and services such as recruitment, consulting and distribution. Each profile says what the business actually does, where that could be verified.

How current is this guide?

The profiles were refreshed in November 2026 from company websites, MCA-derived registries and reputable news sources. Companies change quickly — SAVA Healthcare, for example, sold its companion-animal business in October 2026 — so confirm important details with the company before acting on them.

How can I verify a Pune pharma company before ordering?

Check its drug licence on the Maharashtra FDA portal, confirm the legal entity and registered address in MCA records, verify its GST details, and ask which manufacturing site will make your product and what approvals that site holds. The section above lists these steps in order.

Why do some profiles have no logo or photo?

Only images already published with a listing are used, and each stays with the same company. Where no verified image exists, the profile runs as text only rather than using a substitute picture that might show the wrong business.

Conclusion

Pune's pharma industry runs from a global vaccine giant to one-room marketing firms, and this guide tries to show that whole range honestly: deeper profiles where the public record supports them, short ones where it does not. Use the comparison table to shortlist, the profiles to understand, and the verification steps before you commit to anything.

content.rendered:
Chennai is one of India's oldest pharmaceutical centres. The city and its industrial suburbs host multinational research centres, listed Indian manufacturers, contract manufacturers, vaccine and diagnostics specialists, and hundreds of distributors that supply hospitals and pharmacies across South India.

This guide profiles 104 pharma companies with a Chennai presence, researched from company websites, official registries and directories in November 2026. Each profile states what the company actually does, where it is based, and the facts that could be verified from public sources.

Quick answer: the leading names

  • Tablets (India) Limited and Amrutanjan Health Care are the city's heritage names, founded in 1938 and 1893 respectively.
  • Apex Laboratories (Zincovit), Malladi Drugs (ephedrine and pseudoephedrine APIs) and Medopharm lead the established mid-size manufacturers.
  • Pfizer and Teva run global development centres in Chennai, and AstraZeneca runs a global technology and services hub here.
  • Hospira (Pfizer) and the Steril-Gene joint venture anchor sterile injectables manufacturing linked to the city.
  • Sai Mirra Innopharm, The Madras Pharmaceuticals and Axxelent Pharma Science lead the contract manufacturing (CDMO/CRAMS) group.
  • Palepu Pharma, Shree Amman Pharma and Sugambhika are among the largest distribution houses in the city.

Pharma in Chennai: the sector at a glance

Tamil Nadu is consistently counted among India's top pharmaceutical manufacturing states, and Chennai is its centre of gravity. Production clusters around the industrial estates on the city's western and southern edges, while research and corporate work concentrates along the Taramani technology corridor.

The Alathur SIDCO pharmaceutical estate and the Irungattukottai and Oragadam SIPCOT parks host formulation and API plants. Orchid Pharma built API facilities at Alathur and dosage-form plants at Irungattukottai, and Hospira, now a Pfizer company, later acquired the Irungattukottai injectables business.

  • Formulations first: most Chennai companies make or market tablets, capsules, liquids and topicals, with branded generics the dominant model.
  • Sterile injectables: Hospira's Irungattukottai plant and the Steril-Gene joint venture give the region regulated-market sterile capacity.
  • APIs: Malladi Drugs is a global-scale maker of ephedrine and pseudoephedrine salts, and Orchid's Alathur site anchors bulk-drug production.
  • Research corridor: TICEL Bio Park and the IIT Madras Research Park in Taramani host Pfizer's Global Drug Development Centre, Teva's development centre and biotech firms such as Levim Lifetech.
  • Traditional medicine: Siddha and Ayurvedic research companies such as Dr JRK's, IMIS Pharmaceuticals and Uni-Labs are a distinctive Chennai strength.
  • Distribution hub: large stockists in areas such as Park Town, Kilpauk and Saidapet supply hospitals and retailers across Tamil Nadu and neighbouring states.

Quick comparison: pharma companies in Chennai

Detailed profiles

1. Aarux Pharmaceuticals Pvt Ltd

Aarux Pharmaceuticals is a Chennai company working in nutraceuticals and complementary medicine. Its range is built around eggshell-membrane collagen products for joint health, alongside a colloidal-silver wound cream, a hair-growth serum and gut-health products.

The company's stated focus areas include osteoarthritis, varicose veins and ulcers, hair, skin and nail care, and nerve health. It operates from Anna Nagar West in Chennai.

  • Based in: Anna Nagar West, Chennai
  • Type: nutraceutical and complementary-medicine company
  • Product areas: collagen joint care, wound care, hair and skin care

2. Accede Healthcare (India) Private Limited

Accede Healthcare (India) Private Limited was incorporated in October 2017 and is based in Thousand Lights, Chennai. The company works in the manufacture and export of pharmaceutical products, including finished dosage forms.

Its stated portfolio also covers oncology products, orphan and speciality medicines, medical equipment and healthcare consultancy, which makes it a mixed manufacturing, export and services business rather than a single-product firm.

  • Incorporated: 16 October 2017
  • Based in: Thousand Lights, Chennai
  • Work: finished dosage forms, oncology and speciality products, exports

3. Accord Life Spec Pvt Ltd

Accord Life Spec is a Chennai pharmaceutical formulation company listed in directories as a manufacturer, dealer and exporter. It keeps an office in T. Nagar, Chennai's central business district.

Directory listings also place the company at the SIPCOT Industrial Growth Centre in Oragadam, the industrial corridor south-west of Chennai where several formulation plants are located. Public sources disagree on its founding year, so none is stated here.

  • Based in: T. Nagar, Chennai
  • Also listed at: SIPCOT Industrial Growth Centre, Oragadam
  • Type: formulation manufacturer, dealer and exporter

4. Advanced Biotech Products (P) Ltd

Advanced Biotech Products makes collagen-based biomaterials for wound care and surgery. The Chennai-registered company uses patented collagen technology associated with Encol Corporation of the United States.

Its product families include Helicoll and Healicoll wound dressings, Hemocoll, Surgicoll-Mesh and the Osseograft dental range. The catalogue spans dermal, surgical and dental lines rather than conventional tablets and capsules.

  • Based in: Chennai
  • Focus: collagen-based wound care and surgical products
  • Lines: dermal, surgical and dental products

5. Aeon Formulations Pvt Ltd

Aeon Formulations manufactures and markets pharmaceutical products from Chennai. Its public material places weight on Ayurvedic, healthcare and nutraceutical products alongside conventional formulations.

Public information about the company is limited, and parts of its website have carried unrelated spam content, so this profile sticks to the company's core stated activity: making and marketing formulations and wellness products.

  • Based in: Chennai
  • Work: manufacture and marketing of formulations
  • Focus: Ayurvedic, healthcare and nutraceutical products

6. AGL Pharma Private Limited

AGL Pharma is a Chennai pharmaceutical manufacturer. The company's own material says its products are checked by government-approved external quality-control agencies, a model smaller manufacturers often use instead of large in-house laboratories.

Beyond that, the company publishes little detail about its range or facilities, so buyers should request its licence and product list directly.

  • Based in: Chennai
  • Type: pharmaceutical manufacturer
  • Quality control: external checks by government-approved agencies (company-stated)

7. AMR Pharma India Private Limited

AMR Pharma India Private Limited was incorporated in June 2013 and is based in Anna Nagar West, Chennai. Registry summaries describe it as a maker of solid and liquid oral formulations.

The company describes its unit as WHO-GMP and ISO oriented, producing oral liquids, topicals and cosmetics alongside oral solids. Those certification claims come from the company's own material and are attributed here as such.

  • Incorporated: 17 June 2013
  • Based in: Anna Nagar West, Chennai
  • Makes: oral solids and liquids, topicals and cosmetics

8. Amrutanjan Health Care Ltd.

Amrutanjan is one of India's oldest consumer-health brands. Kasinadhuni Nageswara Rao Pantulu founded the business in Bombay in 1893, and the headquarters moved to Madras in 1914. It has been a public limited company since 1936 and took the name Amrutanjan Health Care Limited in 2007.

From its Mylapore headquarters in Chennai, the company sells pain-management products led by its flagship balm, congestion-relief products, the Comfy women's hygiene range and Fruitnik beverages. It also makes bulk drugs such as theophylline.

  • Founded: 1893
  • Headquarters: Mylapore, Chennai
  • Known for: Amrutanjan Pain Balm
  • Type: listed public company

9. ANS Pharma

ANS Pharma is a small Chennai pharmaceutical trading business based in Kodambakkam. Its IndiaMART profile lists it as a retailer and trader of pharmaceutical tablets and injections, including oncology products such as erlotinib tablets.

Export records also show ANS Pharma shipping medicines through Chennai air cargo. Beyond directory and trade listings, the company publishes little public information, so this profile is deliberately brief.

  • Based in: Kodambakkam, Chennai
  • Type: pharmaceutical trader and retailer
  • Range: tablets and injections, including oncology products (directory-listed)
  • Note: limited public information

10. Anthus Pharmaceuticals Pvt Ltd

Anthus Pharmaceuticals is a Chennai pharmaceutical marketing company. Rather than leading with its own factory, it sells through divisions such as Tritilia for ENT and orthopaedics, Vedus for Ayurvedic products, and dedicated intensive-care and wound-care lines.

The company states that it fields a marketing force of more than 250 people and has its products made at accredited facilities. Those figures are the company's own and are attributed here.

  • Based in: Chennai
  • Type: pharmaceutical marketing company
  • Divisions: ENT and orthopaedics, Ayurvedic, intensive care, wound care

11. Apex Laboratories Private Limited

Apex Laboratories is one of Chennai's established formulation makers. Incorporated in July 1978 and headquartered in Chennai, the company is credited with pioneering zinc formulations in India, and its Zincovit brand remains its best-known product.

The range covers nutraceuticals, oral solids and liquids, and topicals such as the Sofinox cream launched in 2011. Its manufacturing sits near Chennai, in the city's industrial belt.

  • Founded: incorporated 15 July 1978
  • Headquarters: Chennai
  • Known for: Zincovit
  • Makes: nutraceuticals, oral solids and liquids, topicals

12. Apex Laboratories Pvt Ltd

This entry is a second directory listing for Apex Laboratories, the Chennai company profiled directly above at entry 11. Directories carry the company under both "Apex Laboratories Private Limited" and "Apex Laboratories Pvt Ltd".

To avoid repetition, the full profile sits at entry 11: a Chennai-headquartered maker of zinc formulations, known for the Zincovit brand, incorporated in 1978.

  • Note: duplicate listing of the company at entry 11
  • Headquarters: Chennai
  • Flagship brand: Zincovit

13. ARKAMED PHARMAA

ARKAMED PHARMAA is a small Chennai proprietorship based in Royapettah. Directory listings describe it as a retailer and marketer of pharmaceutical products, with a visible emphasis on cardiovascular tablets.

Pharmacy listings credit Arkamed as manufacturer or marketer of cardiovascular brands including Clopeart AS, Nitrokaa, Carvedka and Metarka. Public information is limited to such listings.

  • Based in: Royapettah, Chennai
  • Type: proprietorship; pharma retail and marketing
  • Focus: cardiovascular tablets

14. AstraZeneca India Pvt Ltd

AstraZeneca's Chennai presence is a services hub, not a factory. The city hosts the company's Global Innovation and Technology Centre, described in recent reporting as a strategic centre for information technology, global business services and global operations, including supply chain and strategy work.

AstraZeneca India's separate Bengaluru hub covers research and digital health. In November 2026 reporting, Naveen Krishna Yamarthi took charge as managing director of the Indian entity and head of the Chennai centre.

  • Chennai presence: Global Innovation and Technology Centre
  • Focus: IT, global business services, supply chain operations
  • Type: multinational subsidiary (no Chennai manufacturing)

15. AURA Biotechnologies Private Limited

AURA Biotechnologies works in diagnostics rather than medicines. The company began in 2014 and is based in Ayanambakkam, Chennai, where it runs research, production and sales for diagnostic kits and reagents.

Its catalogue covers molecular diagnostics, immunology and recombinant proteins, serving human healthcare as well as veterinary, poultry and aquaculture testing. The company operates a GMP manufacturing facility of about 15,000 square feet in Chennai.

  • Started: 2014
  • Based in: Ayanambakkam, Chennai
  • Makes: diagnostic kits, reagents and recombinant proteins
  • Facility: GMP plant in Chennai

16. Awfis Aristo

Awfis Aristo is not a pharmaceutical company. It is a coworking and flexible-workspace centre run by Awfis Space Solutions in the Aristo Building, Thiru Vi Ka Industrial Estate, Ekkattuthangal, Chennai, close to the Guindy industrial area.

It appears in pharma directory listings because businesses, including healthcare and pharma offices, rent space there. It is included so readers are not misled: no medicines are made or sold by this listing itself.

  • Type: flexible workspace (not a medicine manufacturer)
  • Location: Ekkattuthangal, Chennai
  • Operator: Awfis Space Solutions

17. Axxelent Pharma Science Pvt. Ltd

Axxelent Pharma Science is a Chennai-headquartered contract development and manufacturing organisation (CDMO), incorporated in 2019. It offers development and manufacturing across oral solids, injectables, ophthalmic products, oral liquids and topicals.

The company positions its Chennai operations for regulated markets, naming the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Europe and China among the markets it serves.

  • Incorporated: 2019
  • Headquarters: Chennai
  • Type: CDMO
  • Dosage forms: oral solids, injectables, ophthalmic, oral liquids, topicals

18. Bafna Pharmaceuticals Ltd

Bafna Pharmaceuticals began in 1981 as a proprietary concern and set up its first unit at Madhavaram, Chennai in 1984. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is listed on the stock exchange.

Bafna makes betalactam and non-betalactam formulations and works as a contract manufacturer and exporter. Its Grantlyon facility near Red Hills has been described in filings as holding EU-GMP, UK-MHRA and TGA accreditations. The company is now a subsidiary of SRJR Lifesciences LLP.

  • Started: 1981; incorporated 1995
  • Base: Madhavaram and Red Hills area, Chennai
  • Makes: betalactam and non-betalactam formulations
  • Type: listed company

19. Beejan Pharmaceuticals

Beejan Pharmaceuticals is a partnership firm based on Anna Salai at Thousand Lights, Chennai. Directory and company material describe it as a manufacturer and marketer of pharmaceutical products, with a field force working across Tamil Nadu.

Products associated with the firm in pharmacy listings include Bee-Resq, Mecmium and Calciraib. As a partnership, it publishes less formal information than the limited companies on this list.

  • Based in: Thousand Lights, Anna Salai, Chennai
  • Type: partnership firm
  • Work: manufacturing and marketing across Tamil Nadu

20. Biomiicron Pharma india Pvt Ltd

Biomiicron is a Chennai formulation brand with a long trading history: the brand dates to 1999, when it was founded by S. M. K. Ketchaani Rajan, while the present private limited company was incorporated in June 2012 and is registered in Kodambakkam.

Its range covers liquid orals, capsules, tablets, ointments and protein powders, spanning allopathic and Ayurvedic lines in directory descriptions.

  • Brand founded: 1999
  • Company incorporated: 28 June 2012
  • Based in: Kodambakkam, Chennai
  • Makes: tablets, capsules, liquid orals, ointments, protein powders

21. Biomiicron Pharmaceutical

This entry is a second listing for Biomiicron, the Kodambakkam-based formulation company profiled at entry 20. The same company appears in directories as both "Biomiicron Pharma India" and "Biomiicron Pharmaceutical", and both listings use the same logo.

The full profile is at entry 20: a brand dating to 1999, incorporated in its present form in 2012, making tablets, capsules, liquid orals, ointments and protein powders.

  • Note: duplicate listing of the company at entry 20
  • Based in: Kodambakkam, Chennai

22. Cloud 7 Pharma private limited

Cloud 7 Pharma is one of the newest companies on this list. It was incorporated in April 2023 and is based in Ramapuram, Chennai.

Registries classify it in pharmaceutical wholesale and distribution, and directory listings describe a wholesaler and distributor of peptides and pharmaceutical tablets. The company also markets its own brands, including a slimming product sold as Cloud Slim.

  • Incorporated: 5 April 2023
  • Based in: Ramapuram, Chennai
  • Type: wholesaler and distributor
  • Range: peptides and pharmaceutical tablets

23. Delvin Formulations Pvt. Ltd.

Delvin Formulations is a Chennai formulation exporter. Its range has been organised into divisions covering chronic care, gastroenterology, diabetics and a general line sold under the Prima name.

Delvin is now part of Sai Mirra Innopharm, the Chennai contract research and manufacturing group profiled at entry 73, so enquiries for its products route through that group.

  • Based in: Chennai
  • Type: formulation exporter
  • Divisions: chronic, gastro, diabetics, general
  • Note: now part of Sai Mirra Innopharm

24. DONAS DRUGS AND PHARMACEUTICALS PVT LTD.,

DONAS Drugs and Pharmaceuticals was incorporated in November 2015, with its registered office in T. Nagar, Chennai. Registry classifications describe the company mainly in wholesale distribution.

The Tamil Nadu Drugs Control department's manufacturer directory separately lists a DONAS address at Vanagaram, Chennai, with manufacturing licences recorded from 2017. Buyers should confirm which licence and site apply to any product they source.

  • Incorporated: 30 November 2015
  • Registered office: T. Nagar, Chennai
  • Also listed at: Vanagaram, Chennai (state manufacturer directory)
  • Type: wholesale distribution and licensed manufacturing listing

25. Dr.JRK’s Research and Pharmaceuticals Pvt Ltd

Dr JRK's Research and Pharmaceuticals is a Siddha and Ayurveda research company founded by Padma Shri Dr J. R. Krishnamoorthy. It is based at Kunrathur, Chennai.

The company is best known for its Psorolin range for psoriasis, alongside products such as Nilavembu Kudineer and D-co-D. It states that its work covers more than 40 formulations supported by over 150 publications; those figures are the company's own.

  • Based in: Kunrathur, Chennai
  • Focus: Siddha and Ayurvedic research products
  • Known for: Psorolin range, Nilavembu Kudineer

26. Elance Pharma

Elance Pharma is a Chennai pharmaceutical marketing company. Its public material organises the business around therapy areas rather than a factory: diabetology, cardiology, gynaecology and orthopaedics.

As with other marketing-led firms on this list, products sold under its brands are manufactured by third-party units, so buyers should ask which licensed site makes each product.

  • Based in: Chennai
  • Type: pharmaceutical marketing company
  • Therapy areas: diabetology, cardiology, gynaecology, orthopaedics

27. Enma Pharmaceuticals Private Limited

Enma Pharmaceuticals was incorporated in April 2004 and is based in Anna Nagar West, Chennai. Registry records place it in pharmaceutical retail and distribution.

Directory descriptions associate the company with generic medicines and nutraceutical products. It publishes little further public information, so this profile stays brief.

  • Incorporated: 27 April 2004
  • Based in: Anna Nagar West, Chennai
  • Range: generic medicines and nutraceuticals
  • Type: retail and distribution classification

28. Eysys Pharmaceutical Private Limited

Eysys Pharmaceutical is a Chennai-headquartered formulation company with a broad portfolio. Its cardio-diabetic division is the most prominent part of the range in its public material.

The company states a portfolio of more than 250 products and a network of over 400 channel partners. Those numbers come from the company itself and are attributed here rather than independently verified.

  • Headquarters: Chennai
  • Focus: cardio-diabetic range within a broad portfolio
  • Type: formulation marketing company

90. Tanmed Pharma India Private Limited

Tanmed Pharma (I) Private Limited is based at Gerugambakkam, Chennai, and works in formulation development and delivery. Its stated dosage forms cover tablets, capsules, externals, powder sachets and liquid orals.

The range spans pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, health-product and cosmetic segments, which makes Tanmed a development-led manufacturer rather than a single-category brand owner.

  • Based in: Gerugambakkam, Chennai
  • Work: formulation development and manufacturing
  • Forms: tablets, capsules, externals, sachets, liquid orals

91. Tanmed Pharmaceuticals

This entry is a second listing for Tanmed Pharma, the Gerugambakkam formulation company profiled at entry 90. Directories carry it under both "Tanmed Pharma India Private Limited" and "Tanmed Pharmaceuticals", using the same logo.

The full profile is at entry 90: formulation development and delivery across tablets, capsules, externals, powder sachets and liquid orals.

  • Note: duplicate listing of the company at entry 90
  • Based in: Gerugambakkam, Chennai

92. Teva Pharma Development centre (Teva company)

Teva's Chennai site is the Actavis Pharma Development Centre, a Teva company, at TICEL Bio Park Phase 1 in Taramani. It is a development centre, not a commercial factory.

Recruitment and company material describe formulation development, analytical research and stability work on oral solid dosage forms and non-oral forms such as injectables, ointments and ophthalmic drops, supporting Teva's global generics business.

  • Site: TICEL Bio Park, Taramani, Chennai
  • Role: pharmaceutical development centre (R&D, stability, analytical)
  • Parent: Teva Pharmaceutical Industries

93. The Madras Pharmaceuticals

The Madras Pharmaceuticals began in 1979, started by five professionals, and has grown into a contract research and manufacturing (CRAMS) business. The company states that it runs seven manufacturing units.

It covers all major dosage forms and states exports to more than 60 countries; the export figure is the company's own. Its group also stands behind the Steril-Gene joint venture profiled at entry 85.

  • Started: 1979
  • Based in: Chennai
  • Type: contract research and manufacturing (CRAMS)
  • Units: seven manufacturing units (company-stated)

94. Ticel Bio Park Phase 2

Ticel Bio Park Phase 2 is not a company but a research park: TICEL Bio Park at Taramani, Chennai, developed by TIDCO with TIDEL Park to house biotechnology and pharmaceutical research.

Phase I opened in 2004 and Phase II, with about 6.49 lakh square feet, opened in September 2015 on the same five-acre CSIR Road campus. Tenants include the Teva development centre and Levim Lifetech, both profiled separately in this guide.

  • Type: biotechnology R&D park (infrastructure, not a manufacturer)
  • Location: Taramani, Chennai
  • Phase II opened: September 2015

95. TIL Healthcare Pvt Ltd (Corporate Office)

TIL Healthcare is a Jhaver-group company based in Chennai, linked to the same group as Tablets (India) Limited. It sells branded and generic formulations and nutraceuticals, and offers finished-dosage and CDMO services.

The company describes a 35-year journey with operations in more than 54 countries and over 650 product registrations. Those figures are company-stated.

  • Group: Jhaver group
  • Based in: Chennai
  • Work: branded and generic formulations, nutraceuticals, CDMO services

96. Twenty First Century Pharmaceuticals Pvt Ltd

Twenty First Century Pharmaceuticals, also known as TFCP, was incorporated in March 1986. It is based at the SIDCO Industrial Estate in Ambattur, Chennai.

The company makes tablets, capsules and oral powders for suspension, and is known in directory and company material for clavulanate-based formulations such as co-amoxiclav products. Government listings record it as a DSIR-registered research organisation.

  • Incorporated: 21 March 1986
  • Based in: Ambattur, Chennai
  • Makes: tablets, capsules and oral powders
  • Known for: clavulanate-based formulations

97. Uni-Labs (India) Pvt Ltd

Uni-Labs (India) makes herbal medicines in contemporary formats. The company dates its founding to 1977, with a first manufacturing facility in Chennai that year; the present private limited entity was incorporated in 1995.

It produces poly-herbal formulations such as Asha Hair Oil, Gynovit, Herbex and Rumex Forte, and states that a second unit with research facilities opened at Kancheepuram in 2012. Its Chennai base is at Velappanchavadi, on Poonamallee High Road.

  • Founded: 1977 (company-stated); entity incorporated 8 August 1995
  • Based in: Velappanchavadi, Chennai
  • Focus: poly-herbal formulations
  • Units: Chennai and Kancheepuram

98. Unilink Pharma Pvt. Ltd.

Unilink Pharma is a T. Nagar, Chennai manufacturer and exporter of generic formulations. Its stated dosage forms are tablets, capsules and syrups, with brands including Gripnil, Parasol and Omecap in directory material.

The company claims a WHO-certified facility and exports to more than 80 countries. Both claims come from the company and directory profiles and are attributed here.

  • Based in: T. Nagar, Chennai
  • Type: manufacturer and exporter of generic formulations
  • Forms: tablets, capsules and syrups

99. Universal Pharmaceuticals Limited

Universal Pharmaceuticals Limited was incorporated in July 1990. Its registered office is at Tondiarpet, Chennai, with an office at Egmore, and registry records list its factory at the PIPDIC Industrial Estate in Puducherry.

Kompass and company material describe a maker of tablets, capsules, syrups and injectables, including herbal formulations, which markets its own products and also supplies formulations to other pharmaceutical companies.

  • Incorporated: 27 July 1990
  • Offices: Tondiarpet and Egmore, Chennai
  • Factory: Puducherry
  • Makes: tablets, capsules, syrups, injectables and herbal formulations

100. UPKAR REMEDIES PVT LTD

Upkar Remedies was incorporated in January 1994 and is based at Kilpauk, Chennai. Registry records classify it in pharmaceutical manufacturing.

Filing summaries list products including atorvastatin and clopidogrel tablets among its pharmaceutical products. The company publishes little other public information.

  • Incorporated: 28 January 1994
  • Based in: Kilpauk, Chennai
  • Type: pharmaceutical manufacturer

101. VITACURA PHARMACEUTICALS

Vitacura Pharmaceuticals is an export-oriented formulation company established in 2018, according to the company. Its office is at Porur, Chennai, and it is part of a group that includes LASO Healthcare and Vitacura OTC.

The range covers capsules, tablets, powders, liquid orals, gels, creams, ointments and injectables. The company lists its factory at Udaipur, Rajasthan, described as a WHO-GMP certified unit; that certification claim is the company's own.

  • Established: 2018 (company-stated)
  • Office: Porur, Chennai
  • Type: export-oriented formulations company
  • Factory: Udaipur, Rajasthan

102. Vopec Pharmaceuticals Pvt Ltd

Vopec Pharmaceuticals is a Chennai-linked company that combines Ayurvedic tradition with biotechnology research, including cancer research in its stated programme. It is associated with Dr Pillai and a sister concern, Agastiya Biotech.

Company material claims a US FDA orphan-drug designation for its research direction. That is a company claim, attributed here, and readers should verify current regulatory status directly.

  • Based in: Chennai
  • Focus: Ayurveda-based biotech research
  • Sister concern: Agastiya Biotech

103. Xeno Pharmaaceuticals

This listing belongs to Xeno Pharmaceuticals Private Limited of Kovur, Chennai, a manufacturer and marketer of branded formulations. Pharmacy listings show a strong gynaecology, fertility and hormone range.

Brands sold under the Xeno name include Greatova, Xenodieno, Xenoscorea, Enphene, Greatlet and Xenosoul, alongside general products such as the Doxen antibiotic combination.

  • Based in: Kovur, Chennai
  • Type: manufacturer and marketer of branded formulations
  • Focus: gynaecology, fertility and hormone therapies

104. Zota Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd

Zota Pharmaceuticals Private Limited is a Chennai company incorporated in March 2003 and based at Teynampet. Its own profile describes it as the global pharmaceutical manufacturing and export division of the ATOZ Group, the international arm of Atoz Pharmaceuticals.

It handles manufacturing, regulatory registration, marketing and export of pharmaceutical products to emerging markets. It is a separate company from Zota Health Care of Surat, the group behind the Davaindia retail chain.

  • Incorporated: 28 March 2003
  • Based in: Teynampet, Chennai
  • Role: export arm of the ATOZ group

How to choose a Chennai pharma supplier

Chennai's pharma market mixes global research centres, audited export plants and small trading firms. The checks below help separate a licensed manufacturer from a marketing office before you place an order or sign a franchise agreement.

  • Confirm the manufacturing licence number and site address against the Tamil Nadu Drugs Control department's published directories.
  • Ask for current GMP or WHO-GMP certificates, and for regulated-market approvals (for example US FDA or EU-GMP) where the supplier claims them.
  • Verify the legal entity behind the brand: incorporation details and registered address are public through MCA-derived registries such as Zaubacorp and The Company Check.
  • For distributors, ask for authorised-stockist letters from the manufacturers they claim to represent, and check cold-chain storage for vaccines and biologics.
  • Search for regulatory actions and alerts before committing: licences can be suspended, as the Sresan case in this list shows.
  • Visit the site, start with a trial order, and confirm who actually manufactures the product if you are dealing with a marketing company.

Frequently asked questions

Which are the largest pharma companies in Chennai?

By history and scale, the standout names are Tablets (India) Limited (founded 1938), Amrutanjan Health Care (1893), Apex Laboratories, Medopharm and Malladi Drugs. Multinationals add research weight rather than factories: Pfizer, Teva and AstraZeneca all run major Chennai centres.

Which parts of Chennai have the most pharma factories?

Manufacturing clusters around the western and southern industrial belts: Alathur, Irungattukottai, Oragadam, Ambattur, Madhavaram and Thirumudivakkam. Research and development concentrates in Taramani, around TICEL Bio Park and the IIT Madras Research Park.

Do Chennai pharma companies export?

Yes. Sai Mirra Innopharm, Medopharm, Global Pharma Healthcare and Unilink Pharma all describe export businesses, and Malladi Drugs supplies API customers in regulated markets including the United States and Europe. Export claims in this guide are attributed to the companies or their filings.

How can I verify a Chennai pharma supplier?

Check the company's licence in the Tamil Nadu Drugs Control directory, confirm its CIN and registered address in an MCA-derived registry, and ask for GMP certificates that name the actual manufacturing site. A marketing company's address is not proof of a factory.

Are all 104 entries manufacturers?

No. The list reflects Chennai's real pharma economy, so it also includes distributors, marketing companies, a contract research organisation, a software company, two research parks and one coworking centre that appeared in directory listings. Each profile states plainly what the organisation does.

Why do some companies appear twice in the list?

Directory data often lists the same company under two name variants or two addresses. Apex Laboratories, Biomiicron, Global Pharma Healthcare, Palepu Pharma and Tanmed each appear twice for this reason, and the second entry is marked as a duplicate rather than padded out.
