content.rendered:
Bengaluru is one of India’s most research-led pharmaceutical and biotechnology centres, and it is also a city of very different kinds of listings. Global research groups, listed manufacturers, family-run formulation companies, distributors, packaging specialists and single-site facilities all appear side by side in local directories.

This guide rewrites the Bangalore list from fresh research. It keeps the same 96 listed entries in the same order, keeps every existing logo or image with the entry it belonged to, and flags facilities, duplicates and entries where public information is limited.

Quick answer

If you only have time for a shortlist, start with the entries that combine scale, a clear Bengaluru base and well documented operations:

  • Biocon Pharma Limited: generic formulations from the Biocon group, founded in Bengaluru in 1978.
  • Micro Labs Limited: Bengaluru formulations maker incorporated in 1973, known for Dolo-650.
  • Medreich Limited: Bengaluru CMO and CDMO business, incorporated in 1973 and part of Meiji Seika Pharma.
  • Strides Pharma Science Limited: Bengaluru headquartered maker of niche finished dosage formulations, with a Chandapura plant and a Bannerghatta Road R and D centre in this list.
  • Syngene’s clinical development unit: part of Syngene International, the Biocon group’s contract research, development and manufacturing organisation.
  • Karnataka Antibiotics and Pharmaceuticals Limited (KAPL): a Government of India enterprise based at Peenya.
  • Sami-Sabinsa Group Limited: Peenya based producer of herbal extracts, nutraceuticals and specialty chemicals.

Pharma and biotech in Bengaluru: the sector in brief

Karnataka was an early mover in biotechnology, launching India’s first dedicated state biotechnology policy in 2001. The current Karnataka Biotechnology Policy 2024-2029 aims to position the state as a global leader, with work on bio-manufacturing, translational research, start-up incubation, workforce development and simpler regulation.

A Karnataka government biotechnology newsletter describes a state ecosystem of more than 800 companies across biopharma, bio-agriculture, bio-industrial work, bio-IT and bio-services, alongside more than 25 national and state research centres. Bengaluru is the centre of that ecosystem, helped by institutions such as the Indian Institute of Science and the National Centre for Biological Sciences.

The city’s character is research-led. Biocon, founded in Bengaluru in 1978, grew from enzymes into biosimilars, generics and research services, and its subsidiary Syngene works as a contract research, development and manufacturing organisation. Around them sits a wide base of formulation plants, contract researchers, excipient and packaging suppliers, and marketing-led companies.

  • Peenya, in north-west Bengaluru, is the older industrial belt in this list, home to KAPL, Sami-Sabinsa, Anglo-French Drugs and several smaller manufacturers and packagers.
  • Bommasandra and Jigani, to the south, hold larger plants and research sites, including Apotex’s API facility, Stericon, Sterin Labs and the Syngene and Biocon Park area.
  • Electronic City and Hosur Road host research and corporate sites linked to Biocon and Syngene, while Whitefield and Manyata Embassy Business Park hold offices for groups such as AstraZeneca Pharma India, Indegene and Pharmed.
  • Many entries are marketing, franchise or distribution businesses rather than factories, so the entry type matters as much as the name.

Quick comparison: the 96 listed entries

Detailed profiles

1. Abbvie India Private Limited

AbbVie’s Bengaluru presence sits on Kasturba Road in central Bengaluru. Fresh registry research did not find a separate MCA entity under the exact listing name; the Bangalore entities at the address are AbbVie Therapeutics India Private Limited and AbbVie Healthcare India Private Limited. AbbVie India’s sourced focus includes eye care, with glaucoma, ocular surface and retinal diseases named in its India material.

  • Bangalore entities include AbbVie Therapeutics India Private Limited, incorporated in 1994 and formerly Allergan India Limited
  • AbbVie Healthcare India Private Limited was incorporated in 2008
  • Sourced focus: biopharmaceutical treatments, including eye care

2. Acurela Pharms Limited

Acurela Pharms Limited is a Bengaluru public company incorporated in 2021, with its registered address at Vijayanagar. The company describes its specialisation as manufacturing and marketing anaesthesia and critical-care products, including emergency medicine. Its registry classification covers other chemical products, so buyers should confirm the exact product licence for any medicine they plan to source.

  • Incorporated: 20 July 2021, RoC Bangalore
  • Registered address: M R H B Colony, Vijayanagar, Bengaluru
  • Focus: anaesthesia, critical care and emergency medicine

3. ANGLO FRENCH DRUGS AND INDUSTRIES LTD

Anglo-French Drugs and Industries Limited, known as AFDIL, began its journey in 1923 and keeps its head office at Peenya Industrial Area in Bengaluru. The company is a pharmaceutical manufacturer long associated with nutritional healthcare, and it describes itself as India’s first maker of single vitamin injections and a B-complex combination. Its range runs to more than 300 products across several divisions.

  • Founded: journey began in 1923
  • Head office: Plot No. 4, Phase II, Peenya Industrial Area, Bengaluru
  • Divisions include AFD Pharma, Hospicare, Optima, Trading and Export
  • Range: 300+ products, with a nutritional healthcare focus

4. Apotex Pharmachem India Pvt Ltd 4th Gaet

This entry is a facility, not a separate company. Apotex Pharmachem India Private Limited operates at Site No. 1A in the 4th Phase of Bommasandra Industrial Area, on Jigani Link Road. It is the Indian arm of the Canadian Apotex group and runs a cGMP facility for research, scale-up and manufacture of active pharmaceutical ingredients, with multi-purpose plants and kilo laboratories.

  • Facility: Bommasandra Industrial Area, 4th Phase, Bengaluru
  • Parent group: Apotex, Canada
  • Work: API research, scale-up and manufacture

5. Astraea Life Sciences Pvt.Ltd.

Astraea Life Sciences Private Limited was incorporated in Bengaluru in 2013 and operates from Banashankari 3rd Stage. Directory and product sources describe a company marketing medicines across southern India in gynaecology and IVF, ENT, orthopaedics, cardiology, diabetes and paediatrics. Named products in medicine listings include Calblend, Glonerve Plus, Zifpod, Aftron and Powergest.

  • Incorporated: 7 November 2013, RoC Bangalore
  • Base: Banashankari 3rd Stage, Bengaluru
  • Segments: gynae/IVF, ENT, ortho, cardio, diabetic and paedia

6. ASTRAZENECA PHARMA INDIA LTD

AstraZeneca Pharma India Limited is a listed Indian arm of the AstraZeneca group, incorporated in 1979. Its registered office is at Manyata Embassy Business Park on Outer Ring Road in Bengaluru. The company is the group’s pharmaceutical products business in India, and its India disclosures are published through its official astrazeneca.in website.

  • Incorporated: 11 July 1979
  • Company type: public limited, subsidiary of AstraZeneca Pharmaceuticals AB
  • Registered office: Manyata Embassy Business Park, Bengaluru

7. Atrimed Pharmaceuticals Pvt Ltd

Atrimed Pharmaceuticals Private Limited, incorporated in Bengaluru in 2003, works on plant-science based healthcare. Its research looks at therapeutic plant molecules, and its published focus areas include therapeutic skin care, therapeutic nutrition, cancer adjuvants and neglected diseases. The company’s office address is at Prestige Meridian on MG Road in Bengaluru.

  • Incorporated: 3 July 2003
  • Base: Prestige Meridian, MG Road, Bengaluru
  • Focus: plant molecules, skin care, nutrition and cancer adjuvants

8. Atrimed Warehouse

This entry is a warehouse facility of Atrimed Pharmaceuticals Private Limited, not a separate company. Listings place it at Featherlite Spectrum on Mysore Road, near the Satellite Bus Stop in Bengaluru. Atrimed’s own online shop states that its products are dispatched from its warehouse in Bangalore, which is the clearest sourced description of this site’s role.

  • Facility of: Atrimed Pharmaceuticals Private Limited
  • Location: Mysore Road, Bengaluru
  • Role: product storage and dispatch

9. Aurz Pharmaceuticals Private Limited

Public information on Aurz is limited. Registry research shows the legal name as Aurz Pharmaceutical Private Limited, incorporated in Bengaluru in 2007 with a registered address on Govindappa Road in Basavanagudi. Its registry activity covers pharmaceuticals, medicinal chemicals and botanical products, and medicine listings name it as the manufacturer of products such as Ducof-B Sugar Free Syrup and Axcet M Tablet.

  • Limited public information: no official website found
  • Incorporated: 5 November 2007, RoC Bangalore
  • Registered address: Basavanagudi, Bengaluru

10. Avyukt Pharmaceuticals | Third party Manufacturer company | Pharma Third Party Manufacturer | Diabetic Products Manufacturer.

Avyukt Pharmaceuticals is a Bengaluru based manufacturer listed at Yeshwanthpur, in the market since 2011 according to its IndiaMART profile. It makes finished formulations such as tablets, capsules and ointments and offers third-party manufacturing, with a notable focus on diabetic and antidiabetic products. Its profile also mentions a finished-products facility in Roorkee, so the plant location should be confirmed before placing an order.

  • Base: Yeshwanthpur, Bengaluru
  • In the market since 2011, per its IndiaMART profile
  • Work: tablets, capsules, ointments and third-party manufacturing
  • Focus: diabetic and antidiabetic products

11. Ayurwin Pharma Pvt Ltd

Ayurwin Pharma Private Limited was incorporated in Bengaluru in 2011 as an Ayurvedic pharmaceutical and nutraceutical manufacturer. Directory sources describe an Ayurvedic pharma and nutraceutical plant in Peenya, and product listings give a manufacturer address at Hegganahalli for products such as Ayurwin Nutrislim Plus and Nutrigain. Buyers should note that registry research records the company status as dissolved (liquidated), so it should not be treated as an active supplier without fresh verification.

  • Incorporated: 2 November 2011, RoC Bangalore
  • Registry status found in research: dissolved (liquidated)
  • Products named in listings: Nutrislim Plus and Nutrigain

12. BAL PHARMA ( UNIT 1)

Bal Pharma Unit 1 is a facility of Bal Pharma Limited, not a separate company. Company material identifies Unit I as the formulations plant at Plot No. 21 and 22 in Bommasandra Industrial Area, on Hosur Road in Bengaluru. Readers comparing suppliers should assess the parent company, Bal Pharma Limited, covered in the next profile but one.

  • Facility of: Bal Pharma Limited
  • Unit I role: formulations plant
  • Location: Bommasandra Industrial Area, Bengaluru

13. Bal Pharma Limited

Bal Pharma Limited is a Bengaluru based public company incorporated in 1987, with its corporate office on Palace Road. It manufactures pharmaceutical active ingredients, formulations and Ayurvedic products. Its Bengaluru operations include the Bommasandra formulations plant and a second Bommasandra unit described as an R and D centre and bulk drugs facility.

  • Incorporated: 19 May 1987
  • Company type: public limited
  • Work: APIs, formulations and Ayurvedic products
  • Bengaluru sites: Bommasandra Unit I and Unit II

14. Bangalore Pharmaceutical & Research Laboratory (P) Ltd

Bangalore Pharmaceutical and Research Laboratory Private Limited, known as BPRL, is headquartered on Reservoir Street in Basavanagudi, Bengaluru. The company develops, manufactures and markets herbal and nutraceutical products, including coated and uncoated tablets, hard gelatin capsules and churnas. Its own site says BPRL was founded in 1957, while the MCA incorporation record is dated 1978; the two dates come from different sources and are both reported here.

  • Headquarters: Basavanagudi, Bengaluru
  • Company site states founded in 1957; MCA incorporation recorded in 1978
  • Products: herbal and nutraceutical tablets, capsules and churnas
  • Also offers contract manufacturing

15. Bio-gen Extracts Private Limited – Peenya

Bio-gen Extracts Private Limited keeps its corporate office, Bio-gen House, in Peenya Industrial Area, Bengaluru, while its factory is at Sompura Industrial Area in Dobaspet. Incorporated in 2000, the company manufactures nutraceutical ingredients and is also described as working on active ingredients, therapeutic enzymes, specialty polymers and nutraceutical raw materials.

  • Corporate office: Peenya Industrial Area, Bengaluru
  • Factory: Sompura Industrial Area, Dobaspet
  • Incorporated: 11 July 2000
  • Work: nutraceutical ingredients and raw materials

16. Biocon Campus

Biocon Campus is a place, not a company. It is the Bengaluru campus of Biocon Limited at 20th KM, Hosur Road, Electronic City. Biocon’s own filings give this address as the group’s registered office and refer to Biocon Campus, Bengaluru in director disclosures. The operating company behind this entry is Biocon Limited, whose subsidiary Biocon Pharma Limited is profiled separately below.

  • Facility of: Biocon Limited
  • Address: 20th KM, Hosur Road, Electronic City, Bengaluru
  • Role: Biocon registered office and campus

17. Biocon House

Biocon House is a building used by the Biocon group in Semicon Park, Electronic City Phase II, Bengaluru, not a standalone company. Registry material gives Biocon House, Tower 3, Semicon Park as the registered address of Biocon Biologics Limited. For the operating businesses at this address, readers should look at the Biocon group profiles in this guide.

  • Building used by: Biocon Limited and Biocon Biologics
  • Location: Semicon Park, Electronic City Phase II, Bengaluru
  • Not a separate company

18. Biocon Pharmaceuticals Limited

The sourced legal name for this entry is Biocon Pharma Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of Biocon Limited incorporated in Bengaluru in 2014. It develops and manufactures generic formulations for global markets, including the United States, Europe and other regions. Company material describes an oral solid dosage formulations facility at Bengaluru serving those markets.

  • Legal name: Biocon Pharma Limited
  • Parent: Biocon Limited (wholly owned subsidiary)
  • Incorporated: 31 October 2014
  • Work: generic formulations, including oral solid dosage forms

19. Bionova Research Labs Pvt Ltd

Bionova Research Labs Private Limited, formerly Pragati Biocare Private Limited, is based at Bikasipura Main Road in Yelachenahalli, Bengaluru. The company invites franchisee enquiries for marketing pharmaceutical products on a monopoly basis. Its hiring and company material also describe pharmaceutical and nutraceutical operations, including direct-to-consumer health, wellness and personal-care brands.

  • Base: Yelachenahalli, Bengaluru
  • Former name: Pragati Biocare Pvt Ltd
  • Work: pharmaceutical marketing and franchisee enquiries
  • Also described: nutraceutical and wellness brands

20. BioPharm Drugs & Pharmaceuticals

Public information on BioPharm Drugs and Pharmaceuticals is limited and partly conflicting. A GST record shows a proprietorship of that trade name registered in 2017, with a place of business in Peenya Industrial Area, Bengaluru. A separate supplier listing places a Bengaluru business of the same name at Seshadripuram. Both records categorise the business among chemists and pharmaceutical dealers rather than manufacturers.

  • Limited public information: directory and GST-level records only
  • GST registration date shown: 1 July 2017
  • Listed place of business: Peenya Industrial Area, Bengaluru

21. Biovitamins Private Limited

Biovitamins Private Limited was incorporated in Bengaluru in 2002, with its registered address in Jayanagar. Its registry activity covers pharmaceuticals, medicinal chemicals and botanical products. Product listings name the company as marketer of Biovit branded vitamin products, including Biovit Powder, Biovit Capsule, Biovit Gold and Biovit Omega 369, with a marketer address also in Jayanagar.

  • Incorporated: 3 May 2002, RoC Bangalore
  • Registered address: Jayanagar, Bengaluru
  • Products named in listings: Biovit Powder, Capsule, Gold and Omega 369

22. Bluefish Pharmaceuticals

Bluefish Pharmaceuticals Private Limited is the Indian entity of Sweden’s Bluefish group, incorporated in Bengaluru in 2006. Its India site is a Global Technology and Development Centre at Whitefield in Bengaluru. The group focuses on developing and selling generic medicines, and its own material says the Bangalore development laboratory supports a portfolio sold across European markets.

  • Indian entity incorporated: 28 September 2006, RoC Bangalore
  • India site: Global Technology and Development Centre, Whitefield, Bengaluru
  • Group focus: development and sale of generic drugs

23. BPREX pharma packaging india pvt ltd

Bprex Pharma Packaging India Private Limited is a Peenya based pharmaceutical packaging company incorporated in 1986. Its registered office is at 13th Cross, IV Phase, Peenya Industrial Area, Bengaluru. Registry sources describe it as a subsidiary of Bprex Plastic Packaging (India) Limited, and record earlier names including Rexam Pharma Bangalore Private Limited and True Pack Private Limited.

  • Incorporated: 16 December 1986, RoC Bangalore
  • Registered office: Peenya Industrial Area, Bengaluru
  • Work: pharmaceutical packaging solutions
  • Earlier names include Rexam Pharma Bangalore Private Limited

24. CAD Pharma Inc.

CAD Pharma Inc. states on its official site that it was incorporated in February 2003 and is based at JP Nagar 3rd Phase in Bengaluru. Its stated objective is helping customers and associates source active ingredients, finished formulations, excipients and intermediates. The company also offers support with regulatory affairs and documentation for markets including Europe and the United States.

  • Incorporated: February 2003, per official site
  • Base: JP Nagar 3rd Phase, Bengaluru
  • Work: sourcing APIs, finished formulations, excipients and intermediates
  • Support: regulatory affairs and documentation

25. Citro Pharma Pvt. Ltd.

Public information on Citro Pharma is limited. Registry sources record Citro Pharma Private Limited as an active Bengaluru company incorporated in 2016, with a registered address at Shampura, K G Halli. Its registry segment covers pharmaceuticals, medicinal chemicals and botanical products, and a product listing names Citropix, a clopidogrel 75 mg product, from Bengaluru. No official website was found during fresh research.

  • Limited public information: no official website found
  • Incorporated: 14 October 2016
  • Registered address: Shampura, K G Halli, Bengaluru
  • Product named in a listing: Citropix (clopidogrel 75 mg)

26. COGNIWELL PHARMACEUTICALS PVT LTD

Cogniwell Pharmaceuticals Private Limited was incorporated in Bengaluru in 2016 and is based near Mariyannapalya and Dasarahalli Village. The company describes its work as marketing a quality range of antibiotic and general-range products. Job listings describe it as a pharmaceutical marketing and distribution company, and product sources name items such as Promocef AZ tablets.

  • Incorporated: 27 April 2016
  • Base: Mariyannapalya / Dasarahalli Village, Bengaluru
  • Work: marketing and distribution of antibiotic and general-range products

27. DFE Pharma India Private Limited

DFE Pharma India Private Limited is not headquartered in Bengaluru. Registry research places its India registered office and production in Cuddalore, Tamil Nadu, while the sourced Bengaluru presence is an office location at Whitefield. The wider DFE Pharma group develops and manufactures excipients for oral solid dosage forms and dry powder inhalation, with Pharmacel microcrystalline cellulose named for the India production site.

  • India registered office and production: Cuddalore, Tamil Nadu
  • Bengaluru presence: Whitefield office location
  • Incorporated: 15 May 2019
  • Group work: functional excipients for solid dose and inhalation products

28. Docventures Pharmaceuticals Private Ltd

Public information on Docventures Pharmaceuticals is limited to directory and product listings; no official website or MCA record was found in fresh research. Listings place Docventures Pharmaceuticals Pvt Ltd at JP Nagar 7th Phase in Bengaluru and categorise it among manufacturers and wholesalers. Medicine platforms name it as marketer of products including Doconac P, Doczone injections, Esodoc 40, Pinoclav and Montebro L.

  • Limited public information: directory-only sources
  • Base: JP Nagar 7th Phase, Bengaluru
  • Establishment year 2011 appears in directory listings only
  • Products named by a medicine platform: Doconac P, Esodoc 40, Pinoclav

29. DORPHYLL HEALTHCARE PRIVATE LIMITED

Dorphyll Healthcare Private Limited is a Bengaluru pharma marketing company based at Netkalappa Circle in Basavanagudi. Its own history says the brand started in 2009 with GANCEF O 200 DT, and that it was incorporated as a private limited company in 2021. Dorphyll works in marketing and promotion, PCD supply and third-party manufacturing of pharmaceutical and niche nutraceutical medicines.

  • Brand started: 2009, per official site
  • Incorporated as private limited: 2021
  • Base: Basavanagudi, Bengaluru
  • Brands named: GANCEF O 200 DT and DORFIX-OF

30. Embiotic Laboratories Pvt. Ltd

Embiotic Laboratories Private Limited was incorporated in Bengaluru in 1988 and operates from Kumbalgodu Industrial Area on Mysore Road. Registry and company sources describe drug formulation and development work. Its dosage forms include tablets, capsules, oro-dispersible tablets, ointments, creams and liquid orals, and sources also describe a standalone beta-lactam manufacturing facility.

  • Incorporated: 29 August 1988
  • Base: Kumbalgodu Industrial Area, Bengaluru
  • Work: formulation development and manufacture
  • Dosage forms include tablets, capsules, ointments, creams and liquid orals

31. Fides Pharmaceuticals

Public information on Fides Pharmaceuticals is limited. A GST record shows Fides Pharmaceuticals as a partnership registered in 2018, based on Castle Street in Ashok Nagar, Bengaluru. Directory categories list it among pharmaceutical and allopathic medicine manufacturers, and a directory description names anti-infective drugs, cough syrups and pharmaceutical tablets. No official website content or MCA company record was found during fresh research.

  • Limited public information: GST and directory records only
  • Legal form: partnership, GST registered 23 August 2018
  • Base: Ashok Nagar, Bengaluru
  • Establishment year 2014 appears in directory listings only

32. FORSKOLIN PHARMA PRIVATE LIMITED

Forskolin Pharma Private Limited was incorporated in Bengaluru in 2018, with an address on Dr D V G Road in Basavanagudi. Registry material places its main line in wholesale trade, while a company directory classifies it in drug formulation and development. An IndiaMART profile describes it as a retail trader of pharmaceutical tablets and syrups. Fresh research found no basis for the older 2013 establishment claim sometimes shown in listings, so that year is not used here.

  • Limited public information
  • Incorporated: 23 October 2018
  • Base: Basavanagudi, Bengaluru
  • Registry line: wholesale trade; directory class: drug formulation and development

33. Givisan Pharma

Givisan Pharmaceutical Private Limited was established in June 2021 and is based on Borewell Road in Whitefield, Bengaluru. On its official site the company describes itself as a distributor of quality pharma products, supplying hospitals, retail pharmacies and wholesale distributors. Its own product pages name brands including GIVIROS GOLD, GIVIPANT, GIVICEF, TELVIAN and GIVIRAB-DSR.

  • Established and incorporated: June 2021
  • Base: Whitefield, Bengaluru
  • Work: distribution to hospitals, pharmacies and wholesalers
  • Brands named on official site: GIVIROS GOLD, GIVIPANT, GIVICEF

34. Hindustan Pharma Distributors

Hindustan Pharma Distributors Private Limited was incorporated in Bengaluru in 2021 and is a subsidiary of Aster DM Healthcare Limited. Its base is on J C Road in Bengaluru. Registry sources place the company in pharmaceutical retail and distribution, with wholesale trading as its main recorded activity.

  • Incorporated: 10 August 2021
  • Parent: Aster DM Healthcare Limited
  • Base: J C Road, Bengaluru
  • Work: pharmaceutical wholesale and distribution

35. Impilo Pharmaceuticals Pvt Ltd

Impilo Pharmaceuticals Private Limited was incorporated in January 2015 and is headquartered in Rajajinagar, Bengaluru. Its official site says the company manufactures and wholesales pharmaceutical formulations and medical supplies for hospitals, clinics and distributors. Its stated focus is women’s health, with formulations across fertility, pregnancy, lactation and wider women’s healthcare.

  • Incorporated: 5 January 2015
  • Headquarters: Rajajinagar, Bengaluru
  • Work: manufacture and wholesale of formulations and medical supplies
  • Focus: fertility, pregnancy, lactation and women’s health

36. Indegene

Indegene Limited is a technology-led healthcare commercialisation company headquartered at Manyata Embassy Business Park in Bengaluru. It was incorporated in 1998. Indegene provides research and commercialisation services to biopharmaceutical and healthcare companies, including pharmaceutical marketing, clinical trial support, pharmacovigilance, medical and regulatory affairs, and health informatics. It is a services company, not a drug manufacturer.

  • Founded and incorporated: 1998
  • Headquarters: Manyata Embassy Business Park, Bengaluru
  • Work: commercialisation, pharmacovigilance, medical and regulatory services
  • Not a drug manufacturer

37. Intralife India

Intra Life Private Limited runs the Intralife India business from a corporate house at B.S.K. 3rd Stage in Bengaluru, with a warehouse on Mysore Road. It is a PCD pharma franchise company offering monopoly and city-wise franchise arrangements. Its official site lists tablets, capsules, injectables, syrups, drops, sachets, softgels, creams and ointments across many therapy segments, from Ayurveda and paediatrics to cardiology and diabetes.

  • Corporate base: B.S.K. 3rd Stage, Bengaluru
  • Warehouse: Mysore Road, Bengaluru
  • Work: PCD franchise on monopoly and city-wise terms
  • Forms listed: tablets, capsules, injectables, syrups, drops and softgels

38. INVISION MEDI SCIENCES Pvt. Ltd.

Invision Medi Sciences Pvt. Ltd. is a Bengaluru pharmaceutical company with addresses sourced at Wilson Garden and on Hosur Road. Company profiles describe a wide product range across ten marketing divisions, including tablets, capsules, injections, syringes, lotions, soaps, syrups, suspensions, infusions, sachets, ointments and eye, ear and nasal drops. An establishment year of 2004 appears in a company profile, but no MCA incorporation record was returned in fresh research.

  • Base: Wilson Garden and Hosur Road addresses, Bengaluru
  • Established 2004 per company profile only
  • Range: tablets, capsules, injections, syrups, ointments and drops
  • Structure: ten marketing divisions, per company profile

39. INVISION PHARMA LIMITED

Invision Pharma Limited is a separate legal entity from Invision Medi Sciences, incorporated in Bengaluru in 2018 and based on Hosur Road. Its official site describes a cosmetic and nutraceutical manufacturer offering private label manufacturing, contract manufacturing and custom formulation services. The service covers formulation development, sampling, manufacturing and packaging support, while registry sources also classify it in drug formulation and development.

  • Incorporated: 21 May 2018
  • Base: Hosur Road, Bengaluru
  • Work: private label and contract manufacturing for cosmetics and nutraceuticals
  • Separate legal entity from Invision Medi Sciences

40. Jubilant Biosys Limited

Jubilant Biosys Limited is an integrated contract research, development and manufacturing organisation. Its registered office is in Noida, while the Bengaluru entry is its research site at Yeshwanthpur. The company was incorporated in 1998 and offers drug discovery, development and GMP manufacturing services to global pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, including an Integrated Drug Discovery Center in Bengaluru.

  • Incorporated: 10 February 1998
  • Bengaluru role: research site at Yeshwanthpur
  • Registered office: Noida, Uttar Pradesh
  • Services: discovery, development and GMP manufacturing

41. Juggat Pharma

Juggat Pharma is not a separate company. It is the pharma division of Jagdale Industries Private Limited, and this listing duplicates the fuller entry that follows. The division’s manufacturing unit is at Anchepalya, Kumbalgodu, on Mysore Road in Bengaluru. Its sourced first-mover products include Botropase, BotroClot and Talsil Forte, which are covered in the next profile.

  • Parent: Jagdale Industries Pvt. Ltd.
  • Duplicate listing: see the next entry for the full profile
  • Manufacturing unit: Kumbalgodu, Mysore Road, Bengaluru

42. Juggat Pharma (Pharma Division of Jagdale Industries Pvt. Ltd.)

  • Work: formulations marketing and national distribution from Bangalore
  • Segments: gynaecology, paediatrics, physician care and dental

93. YMC India Bangalore, Karnataka

The Bengaluru entry is a regional office of YMC India Private Limited, a subsidiary of Japan’s YMC Co. Ltd, not a separate company. YMC India’s official about page places its headquarters at Noida and lists Bangalore among its regional offices. The business supplies analytical and process chromatography products and services for pharmaceutical and biopharmaceutical work, including HPLC and UHPLC columns, preparative columns, bulk media and purification services.

  • Parent: YMC India Private Limited, subsidiary of YMC Co. Ltd, Japan
  • Bengaluru role: regional office; headquarters at Noida
  • Work: analytical and process chromatography
  • Products: HPLC/UHPLC columns, preparative columns, media and systems

94. Zeyyer Pharmaceutical pvt Ltd, Pharmaceutical Company in Bangalore Karnataka India

Zeyyer Pharmaceutical Private Limited is headquartered at Gandhi Nagar in Bengaluru. A company profile describes a pharmaceutical manufacturing and marketing company and a PCD pharma franchise provider, and states that it was formed in 2002. No independent MCA record was found in fresh research, so 2002 is reported as a company claim. Therapeutic areas in its profile include cardiovascular, gastrointestinal, analgesics, haematinics, anti-infectives, respiratory and antidiabetic products.

  • Headquarters: Gandhi Nagar, Bengaluru
  • Formed in 2002 per company profile; not independently verified
  • Work: manufacturing, marketing and PCD franchise
  • Areas: cardiovascular, gastrointestinal, analgesics, anti-infectives and antidiabetics

95. Zriza Pharmaceuticals

Zriza Pharmaceuticals Private Limited was incorporated in Bengaluru in 2013, with its registered office at MEI Colony, Laggere, near Peenya. Its own description places it in personal care and skincare manufacturing, with a dermo-cosmetic focus and a paediatric interest. Products named include Plueur Brightening Serum, Soeil Under Eye Repair Serum, Croitre Anti Hair Fall Serum, Clairz Comedone Control Serum and Ziglow Instant Brightening Wash.

  • Incorporated: 9 December 2013, RoC Bangalore
  • Registered office: Laggere, Bengaluru
  • Work: skincare and dermo-cosmetic manufacturing
  • Products named: Plueur, Soeil, Croitre, Clairz and Ziglow

96. Zumutor Biologics Pvt Ltd

Zumutor Biologics Private Limited is the Indian arm of Zumutor Biologics Inc. and was incorporated in Bengaluru in 2015 as a subsidiary of a company incorporated outside India. Its Bengaluru address at Yeshwanthpur is its research and laboratory base, while the group headquarters is in the Boston area of the United States. The company is a clinical-stage immuno-oncology business working on next-generation immunotherapies aimed at NK cell checkpoints, using its INABLR antibody discovery platform; a candidate named ZM008 appears in a 2026 clinical collaboration announcement.

  • Incorporated: 31 July 2015, RoC Bangalore
  • Bengaluru role: R and D operations and laboratory
  • Group headquarters: Boston area, United States
  • Focus: immuno-oncology and NK cell checkpoint immunotherapies

How to choose a Bangalore pharma partner

Start by matching the entry type to your need. A listed manufacturer, a contract research organisation, a PCD franchise company and a distributor solve different problems, and this list contains all four, plus facilities and offices that belong to larger groups.

  • For manufacturing: ask which site will actually make your product, and check that the site, not just the brand, holds the licences your dosage form needs.
  • For research services: look for a documented track record in your study type, such as stability work, clinical trials or formulation development.
  • For franchise or distribution offers: confirm territory terms, supply continuity and who holds the product licences before paying any deposit.
  • For global groups: confirm whether you are dealing with the Indian subsidiary, a regional office or a single facility, because contracts and compliance sit with the legal entity.

What to verify before you commit

Directory listings age quickly, and several entries in this guide turned out to be facilities, duplicates or businesses with limited public information. A short verification pass protects both buyers and jobseekers.

  • Legal identity: ask for the company identification number or LLP identification number and check it against the name on invoices and agreements.
  • Trading status: confirm the company is active; one entry in this list, Ayurwin Pharma, is recorded as dissolved in registry research.
  • Site role: confirm whether the Bengaluru address is a factory, warehouse, office or training centre before assuming local manufacturing.
  • Product paperwork: for any medicine, ask for the manufacturing licence, product approval and batch documentation for the specific product, not the brand in general.
  • People claims: treat founding years, product lists and facility claims from directories as leads to verify, especially where this guide marks public information as limited.

Frequently asked questions

Is Bengaluru mainly a manufacturing base or a research base?

It is both, with a strong research tilt. The city combines formulation and API plants in industrial areas such as Peenya and Bommasandra with research organisations, clinical trial units and corporate offices linked to groups such as Biocon, Syngene, AstraZeneca and Jubilant Biosys.

Are all 96 entries separate companies?

No. Fresh research found facilities, offices and duplicate listings among the 96 entries, including Biocon Campus, the Medreich units, two listings for Micro Labs and two for KAPL. Each profile says plainly when an entry is a facility or a duplicate, and points to the parent company.

Which Bengaluru areas appear most often in this list?

Peenya and Bommasandra-Jigani appear most often for manufacturing, while Electronic City, Hosur Road, Whitefield and Manyata Embassy Business Park appear for research sites and corporate offices. Older commercial districts such as Basavanagudi, Jayanagar and Chamarajpet host many smaller marketing and distribution companies.

What does “limited public information” mean in a profile?

It means fresh research found only registry, GST or directory level records, and no official website or detailed company material. In those profiles this guide reports only the sourced basics and does not claim founding years, products or certifications that could not be verified.

Does inclusion in this list mean a company is recommended?

No. Inclusion means the entry appeared in the original Bangalore coverage list and was re-researched for this guide. Buyers, partners and candidates should still verify legal identity, trading status, licences and site role using the checks in the section above.

This guide was rebuilt from fresh research in November 2026. Company details change, so confirm time-sensitive facts with the company or the registry before you rely on them.

Hyderabad pharma at a glance

Hyderabad is not a single industrial estate with a few large factories. It is a connected life-sciences market covering discovery research, active ingredients, formulations, vaccines, contract services, distribution and specialist training.

This updated guide keeps the original directory breadth — 110 coverage entries — but rebuilds every profile from research checked on 5 November 2026. Duplicate listings and generic headings are identified honestly rather than dressed up as separate companies.

Quick answer

  • For vaccines and biologics: start with Biological E and Indian Immunologicals.
  • For large-scale APIs and formulations: look first at Aurobindo Pharma, Dr Reddy's Laboratories, MSN Laboratories, Natco Pharma, Hetero Labs and SMS Pharmaceuticals.
  • For research and contract services: Aragen, Aurigene Pharmaceutical Services and Sai Life Sciences are the clearest dedicated service names in this directory.
  • For smaller suppliers and specialists: use the A-to-coverage-order profiles below, then verify the site, licence and product evidence directly with the company.

Why Hyderabad matters in pharmaceuticals

Genome Valley is the research anchor. CBRE's 2025 Global Life Sciences Atlas describes it as home to more than 200 biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies from 18 countries, within what it calls India's largest life-sciences manufacturing and research cluster.

The same CBRE profile attributes nearly one-third of India's pharmaceutical production, about one-fifth of its pharmaceutical exports and about one-third of global vaccine output to Hyderabad. Those are market-level figures, not claims about any single company in the directory.

The city's depth comes from the overlap between bulk drugs and finished medicines. API producers, formulation plants, sterile-injectable specialists, CROs, pharmacovigilance teams and regulatory consultants operate in the same labour and supplier market.

  • Research and development: Genome Valley supports discovery, development and specialist laboratory work.
  • Vaccines and biologics: Biological E and Indian Immunologicals give the cluster unusual scale in human and animal health.
  • APIs and generics: Aurobindo, Dr Reddy's, Hetero, MSN, Natco and SMS anchor a broad export-oriented base.
  • Services: CROs, CDMOs, GMP consultants and training providers support firms that do not keep every function in-house.

Hyderabad Pharma City has also been repositioned as Green Pharma City. Telangana presents it as a sustainable manufacturing and research hub, while the original project vehicle, Hyderabad Pharma City Limited, was created under the state industrial infrastructure corporation to develop the Pharma City project.

How to choose a Hyderabad pharma company

Start with the job, not the brand name. An API enquiry, a sterile-injectable CDMO search and a pharmacovigilance contract require different facilities, licences and evidence.

  • Match the specialism: confirm that the company actually performs the work, rather than trading, marketing or loan-licensing it.
  • Verify the site: distinguish a registered office, corporate office, research centre and manufacturing plant; they are often in different places.
  • Ask for current licences: request the manufacturing or wholesale licence that covers the exact site and dosage form.
  • Check regulatory evidence: where export supply matters, ask which regulator inspected the relevant site and when.
  • Test capacity and timelines: obtain a written quotation that separates development, validation, manufacture, testing and release.
  • Confirm the legal entity: use the CIN and contracting name, especially where a group, brand and site share similar names.

What to verify before you commit

Directory entries can age quickly. A current official website is a starting point, not proof that a particular plant can make a particular product or that a certification covers the work being bought.

For medicines and ingredients, verify batch documentation, quality agreements, audit rights, change notification and recall responsibility before placing an order. For services, verify the named team, data controls, reporting route and regulatory inspection history.

Frequently asked questions

Why is Hyderabad called a vaccine capital?

Hyderabad has an unusually deep concentration of vaccine and biologics capability. CBRE's 2025 life-sciences profile attributes about one-third of global vaccine output to the city and identifies Genome Valley as a cluster of more than 200 life-sciences companies.

What is Genome Valley?

Genome Valley is Hyderabad's organised life-sciences research and clean-manufacturing cluster. It brings together biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies, research organisations and specialist infrastructure in the wider Shamirpet area.

Is Green Pharma City the same as Hyderabad Pharma City?

Green Pharma City is the current branding for the large pharmaceutical city project that developed from Hyderabad Pharma City. It is presented by Telangana as a sustainable manufacturing and research hub, rather than a conventional industrial estate.

Are all 110 entries separate manufacturers?

No. The directory includes manufacturers, service providers, distributors, an industry association, training organisations, facilities, duplicate listings and three generic headings. Each profile identifies the type of entry instead of presenting every name as a separate factory.

Why are duplicate listings retained?

They are retained to preserve the original coverage and image order, but they are labelled as duplicates or site entries. Buyers should contract with the legal entity named in the main company profile, not with a duplicate directory heading.

How current is this guide?

The research was checked on 5 November 2026. Addresses, websites, ownership and regulatory status can change, so the official company and regulator records should be checked again before a commercial decision.

Research notes and sector sources

Company profiles were rebuilt from official company websites first, followed by MCA-derived company records and reputable trade or news sources. Claims that could not be verified were omitted. The detailed source for every profile is logged in the editorial research pack that accompanies this article.

  • CBRE: Hyderabad emerges as one of the top global centres of life sciences manufacturing activity, 2025
  • Business Today: Green Pharma City interview, 2025
  • Telangana Life Sciences: Genome Valley

  • Check reviews: Prioritize 4.5+ ratings with 300+ Google reviews for reliability.

The Big 4 Companies In India — Deloitte, PwC, EY, and KPMG — dominate professional services across audit, tax, consulting, and advisory. Whether you are a fresher exploring campus placements, an MBA graduate targeting consulting, or an experienced CA/CPA looking to switch, this guide compares all four firms on India revenue, offices, salaries, hiring process, work culture, and career paths.

We have pulled verified data on global and India headcount, analyst-to-manager salary bands, hybrid work policies, internship programmes, major clients, and office locations across Bengaluru, Gurugram, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune, Kolkata, and Ahmedabad.

How to Choose Among the Big 4 in India

  • Largest scale & global mobility: Deloitte leads on global revenue (US$70.5B) and India headcount (~140,000).
  • Fastest India revenue growth: PwC reports strong FY26 India revenue (~₹14,000 crore) with flexible hybrid work.
  • Learning & purpose-driven culture: EY invests heavily in EY Badges, graduate rotations, and strategy consulting.
  • People-first hybrid culture: KPMG offers Flex with Purpose and competitive analyst salaries (~₹10.9 lakhs).
  • City preference: All four have major hubs in Mumbai, Gurugram, Bengaluru, and Hyderabad — check office tables below.

Big 4 Companies In India — Quick Comparison

Detailed Company Profiles

1. Deloitte

India HQ: Mumbai  |  India Revenue: ₹10,000 crore (FY24)  |  India Employees: 140,000  |  India Offices: 24 locations

View careers at Deloitte →

Career highlights

  • Core services: Audit, Consulting, Financial Advisory, Risk Advisory, Tax
  • Best for: Ambitious professionals seeking the largest Big 4 brand, global mobility, and diverse service lines.
  • Internship: 2 to 6 months paid summer and virtual internships across consulting, audit, tax, risk advisory, and technology
  • Work model: Hybrid — 2-3 days a week in office
  • Interview difficulty: Medium

Deloitte is one of the premier Big 4 Companies In India, offering an unparalleled platform for ambitious professionals to launch and accelerate their careers. Founded in 1845 by William Welch Deloitte in London, the firm has a rich history of innovation and excellence that has propelled it to become the largest professional services network globally by revenue, reaching an impressive US$70.5 billion in 2025.

In India, Deloitte continues to dominate the market with significant revenue growth and a robust footprint across major cities. Our core services span audit and assurance, management consulting, financial advisory, risk advisory, tax, and legal services, providing our people with diverse opportunities to develop deep expertise and solve complex challenges for top-tier clients.

We pride ourselves on cultivating a dynamic workplace culture that champions continuous learning, inclusivity, and well-being. With structured career paths, global mobility programs, and access to Deloitte University, we empower our employees to achieve their highest potential.

Whether you are a fresh graduate or an experienced professional, joining Deloitte means becoming part of a collaborative community where your ideas matter and your career aspirations can truly take flight in a highly competitive and rewarding market.

Company overview: Deloitte is a British multinational professional services network headquartered in London, England. As the largest professional services network in the world by revenue and number of employees, it is one of the Big Four accounting firms.

History: Founded in 1845 by William Welch Deloitte in London, the firm expanded internationally and evolved through key mergers, notably with Haskins & Sells in 1952 and Touche Ross in 1989 to form Deloitte & Touche. Renamed Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu in 1993, it uniquely retained its consulting division during the early 2000s regulatory shakeups, growing into the world's largest professional services network.

Why choose Deloitte? Deloitte stands out as a leading career choice due to its inclusive work environment, global opportunities, and strong focus on professional development and employee well-being. It offers structured programs, learning via Deloitte University, and customizable career tracks that emphasize mentorship and merit-based advancement.

Brand Finance's Most Valuable Commercial Services Brand (2019-2025), TIME's Best Companies for Future Leaders 2025, and India's Best Companies To Work For (2022-2024).

Pros

  • Global brand recognition
  • Structured growth opportunities
  • Continuous learning and development
  • Generous benefits and PTO
  • Collaborative work culture

Cons

  • High workload and long hours
  • Complex organizational structure

Finding the best perfume in India can feel overwhelming — with hundreds of options from ₹150 budget sprays to ₹4,000+ luxury EDPs. Whether you want a fresh office scent, a bold evening fragrance, or an iconic floral for women, this guide covers 18 top-rated perfumes with full details, comparison tables, and Amazon affiliate links.

We have included Indian affordable luxury brands like Bella Vita, Denver, Wild Stone, and Beardo alongside international icons like Elizabeth Taylor White Diamonds, Lattafa, and Yardley London — so you can pick by budget, occasion, and fragrance family.

How to Choose the Right Perfume in India

  • Budget under ₹300: Park Avenue Voyage, BLABLIBLU Old Money, BELLAVITA combos — great for daily wear.
  • Mid-range ₹300–₹600: Bella Vita CEO Man, Denver packs, Wild Stone, Beardo — best value for longevity.
  • Premium ₹4,000+: Elizabeth Taylor White Diamonds, Lattafa Teriaq — for special occasions and gifting.
  • Office wear: Fresh citrus, aquatic, or light fougère scents (CEO Man, Voyage, Edge).
  • Evening wear: Oud, leather, amber, or spicy oriental notes (Honey Oud, Teriaq, Hamilton & Honour).

Best Perfume in India — Quick Comparison

Launched in 1991, White Diamonds by Elizabeth Taylor is an iconic, bestselling floral aldehyde fragrance for women that blends notes of lily, tuberose, jasmine, and warm amber. This classic perfume embodies the timeless glamour and legendary style of Elizabeth Taylor herself.

The fragrance opens with a sparkling burst of aldehydes, bergamot, neroli, orange, and lily, creating a luminous and inviting introduction. The heart reveals a rich, opulent bouquet of classic florals, including tuberose, jasmine, ylang-ylang, rose, and narcissus, which lend the scent its signature elegance and femininity.

The base notes provide a warm, sensual foundation with oakmoss, patchouli, musk, sandalwood, and amber, ensuring a long-lasting and memorable trail. White Diamonds is perfect for evening wear or special occasions when you want to feel sophisticated and glamorous.

Its enduring popularity is a testament to its exquisite composition and the enduring appeal of its namesake. Whether you are a long-time fan or discovering it for the first time, this fragrance offers a touch of Hollywood luxury that is both captivating and unforgettable.

It remains a true masterpiece in the world of celebrity fragrances.

The fragrance opens with a luscious, golden sweetness of honey, which is both comforting and luxurious. This sweetness is perfectly balanced by the heart and base notes of oud, which provide a deep, resinous, and slightly smoky character.

The combination of these two powerful ingredients creates a complex, intoxicating scent that is perfect for evening wear, special occasions, or cooler weather. As an IFRA-certified and cruelty-free fragrance, Honey Oud ensures a safe and ethical luxury experience.

The use of premium imported oils guarantees a high-quality scent profile that develops beautifully on the skin, lasting up to 8 to 10 hours. Bella Vita has succeeded in creating an affordable yet highly sophisticated oud fragrance, making this exotic and highly sought-after ingredient accessible to a wider audience without compromising on its rich, authentic aroma.

It is an IFRA-certified, cruelty-free fragrance that lasts up to 8 to 10 hours.

14. Midnight Duo — LSD & Mariner (50ml x 2)

Beardo Midnight Duo is a long-lasting, highly concentrated EDP perfume combo for men featuring the LSD and Mariner fragrances, which offer refreshing, masculine scent profiles. This duo is designed to provide versatility and exceptional performance for the modern man.

Mariner is an aquatic, fresh fragrance that captures the essence of the ocean. It features crisp, clean notes that are perfect for daytime wear, keeping you feeling energized and refreshed.

LSD, on the other hand, offers a more intense, enigmatic scent profile that is ideal for evening wear or when you want to make a bold statement. Both fragrances are highly concentrated Eau De Parfums, ensuring that they last for hours on the skin, providing excellent value.

Beardo, an award-winning men's grooming brand, has crafted these scents to appeal to the dynamic, confident man who appreciates high-quality fragrances. The Midnight Duo is a perfect gift or a great way to expand your personal fragrance collection with two distinct, high-performing scents that cover all occasions, from a casual day out to a sophisticated night on the town.

It features highly concentrated EDP formulations from an award-winning perfume brand.

15. Teriaq Intense EDP (100ml)

  • Key strengths: Arabian craftsmanship, long-lasting fragrances, and premium ingredients at an affordable price range
  • Best for: Premium unisex evening fragrance with Arabian spicy depth.

Launched in 2024, Teriaq Intense by Lattafa is a bold, long-lasting unisex Oriental Spicy fragrance crafted by master perfumer Quentin Bisch that features notes of saffron, bergamot, plum liquor, cinnamon, amber, and tonka bean. This luxurious Arabian fragrance is a true masterpiece of olfactory art, offering an incredibly rich and complex scent experience.

The opening is a vibrant mix of spicy saffron and fresh bergamot, which immediately grabs attention. The heart reveals a decadent blend of plum liquor and cinnamon, adding a sweet, boozy, and spicy warmth that is utterly intoxicating.

The base notes of amber and tonka bean provide a deep, sensual, and long-lasting foundation that lingers on the skin for hours on end. Teriaq Intense is a testament to Lattafa's commitment to delivering premium, high-quality Arabian fragrances at an accessible price point.

The craftsmanship of Quentin Bisch is evident in the seamless blending of these rich ingredients, resulting in a fragrance that is both opulent and modern. Perfect for evening wear and special occasions, this perfume is sure to turn heads and leave a lasting impression.

It was crafted by master perfumer Quentin Bisch and launched in 2024.

16. King Perfume for Men (100ml)

Brand: Wild Stone  |  Price: ₹339  |  Rating: 3.8/5  |  Type: Mass Market

Fragrance highlights

  • Popular categories: Men's Perfumes, Body Sprays, Deodorants, Grooming, Gifts
  • Key strengths: Highly affordable, wide accessibility, and mass-appealing masculine fragrances
  • Best for: Long-lasting bold leather-vanilla scent at mass-market pricing.

Wild Stone King, launched by McNROE Consumer Products, is a bold and premium Eau De Parfum for men that blends zesty notes of grapefruit and lemon with aromatic lavender, luxurious leather, and warm vanilla. This fragrance is designed to make you feel like royalty, offering a commanding and sophisticated scent profile.

The top notes of grapefruit and lemon provide a bright, energetic opening that is instantly refreshing. The heart of the fragrance features calming lavender, which adds a touch of classic elegance.

The true power of King lies in its base, where the rich, masculine scent of leather is perfectly balanced by the comforting sweetness of vanilla. This combination creates a deep, enduring fragrance that exudes confidence and authority.

With an intense 40% perfume concentration, Wild Stone King offers exceptional longevity, lasting up to 12 hours on the skin. Its vegan formulation ensures an ethical choice for consumers.

Highly affordable yet uncompromising in quality, this perfume is a fantastic option for men who want a bold, mass-appealing fragrance that delivers premium performance all day long.

It features a vegan formulation with an intense 40% perfume concentration that lasts up to 12 hours.

17. Gentleman Classic Liquid Perfume Spray

Launched in 2019, Gentleman Classic by Yardley London is a modern, sophisticated masculine fragrance featuring fresh woody fougère notes, fresh citrus, black pepper, and cardamom interlaced with soft floral notes on a warm base of amber, musk, and sandalwood. This fragrance represents the perfect fusion of traditional English heritage and contemporary elegance.

The opening is crisp and spicy, with citrus and black pepper providing an invigorating start. The heart notes introduce a refined blend of cardamom and soft florals, adding complexity and a touch of gentlemanly grace.

The base is rich and warm, with amber, musk, and sandalwood creating a comforting and long-lasting trail. Yardley London, a brand with a history dating back to 1770 and a holder of six Royal Warrants, brings its centuries of expertise to this classic scent.

Gentleman Classic is vegan-friendly and cruelty-free, reflecting modern ethical standards while maintaining the exceptional quality the brand is known for. It is the ideal fragrance for the discerning man who appreciates timeless sophistication and affordable luxury, perfect for both professional environments and formal occasions.

It has held six Royal Warrants and features products that are vegan-friendly and cruelty-free.

BELLAVITA Narco & Devil is a premium unisex Eau de Parfum duo that blends fresh charm with dark seduction. Sourced with imported luxury oils from France, Spain, and Italy, the Narco fragrance offers a light, captivating profile with bergamot and soft floral notes, while Devil provides an intense twist featuring saffron and cotton candy notes.

This combo is designed to cater to the dual nature of modern individuals, offering a scent for every mood. Narco is perfect for daytime wear, providing a fresh, uplifting, and elegant aura that is universally appealing.

Devil, in contrast, is an enigmatic and seductive fragrance, ideal for evening wear and special occasions. The unique combination of spicy saffron and sweet cotton candy in Devil creates a bold, unforgettable scent that commands attention.

Both perfumes are crafted with high-quality, imported oils, ensuring a luxurious experience and impressive longevity. BELLAVITA continues to democratize luxury with this duo, offering premium, complex fragrances at an affordable price.

Whether you want to exude fresh charm or dark seduction, the Narco & Devil combo has you covered.

It is a unisex perfume combo crafted with imported oils from France, Spain, and Italy.

India’s coffee culture has exploded — from traditional South Indian filter coffee to cold brew, flavored instant, and premium freeze-dried blends. Whether you want an affordable daily cup or a luxury cafe-style experience at home, the best coffee brands in India offer something for every taste and budget. Below is a complete comparison table followed by detailed profiles of 12 top brands with prices, ratings, flagship products, and Amazon links.

Best Coffee Brands in India — Quick Comparison

Detailed Brand Profiles

1. Sleepy Owl

Check price on Amazon →

Sleepy Owl is a homegrown Indian coffee brand that has revolutionized the way people consume coffee by introducing innovative products like cold brew bags and premium instant coffee.

Founded in 2016 by three friends, Ajai Thandi, Arman Sood, and Ashwajeet Singh, the brand aimed to provide high-quality, freshly roasted coffee that is easy to brew at home. Their signature cold brew is steeped for 24 hours to extract a smooth, bold, and less acidic flavor profile that appeals to modern coffee drinkers.

Over the years, Sleepy Owl has expanded its portfolio to include hot brew bags, ready-to-drink iced coffee, and a range of flavored instant coffees, all made from 100% Arabica beans sourced from Chikmagalur, Karnataka.

The brand’s commitment to quality, sustainability, and aesthetic packaging has garnered a loyal customer base across India. With a strong direct-to-consumer model and an increasing presence in retail stores, Sleepy Owl continues to be a favorite among coffee enthusiasts looking for a convenient yet premium coffee experience without the need for expensive equipment.

Notable fact: Sourced from Chikmagalur.

2. Bru

Check price on Amazon →

Bru is one of India’s most iconic and trusted coffee brands, holding a special place in the hearts of millions of coffee lovers since its inception in 1968. Launched by Hindustan Unilever Limited (HUL), Bru was the first brand to introduce instant coffee mixed with chicory to the Indian market, creating a unique flavor profile that closely resembles the traditional South Indian filter coffee.

The brand’s flagship product, Bru Instant, is a perfect blend of high-quality Robusta and Arabica beans sourced from the finest plantations in South India. Over the decades, Bru has expanded its offerings to cater to evolving consumer preferences, introducing premium variants like Bru Gold, which is made from 100% pure coffee, and specialized filter coffee powders.

Bru’s enduring success can be attributed to its deep understanding of the Indian palate, offering a rich, aromatic, and comforting cup of coffee that brings families together. With its widespread distribution network, affordable pricing, and consistent quality, Bru continues to be a staple in households across the country, celebrating the joy of sharing a warm cup of coffee.

Notable fact: First instant coffee mixed with chicory in India.

3. Bevzilla

Check price on Amazon →

Bevzilla is a dynamic and innovative Indian beverage brand that has taken the coffee market by storm with its unique and convenient product offerings. Founded in 2020 by Divisha Chaudhry and Anurag Chhabra, the brand was born out of a desire to provide a healthier, tastier, and more convenient alternative to traditional instant coffee.

Bevzilla’s flagship product, the coffee cubes, revolutionized the way people make coffee on the go. These cubes are made from 100% pure Arabica beans and are naturally sweetened with date palm jaggery, offering a delicious and guilt-free coffee experience without the need for refined sugar.

In addition to their famous cubes, Bevzilla offers a wide range of flavored instant coffee powders, including hazelnut, vanilla, and butterscotch, packaged in convenient sachets. The brand’s commitment to using plant-based ingredients and avoiding artificial preservatives has resonated well with health-conscious consumers.

With its vibrant branding, focus on innovation, and strong online presence, Bevzilla has quickly established itself as a popular choice for modern coffee drinkers looking for quality, convenience, and great taste in every cup.

Notable fact: Known for naturally sweetened coffee cubes.

4. Davidoff

Check price on Amazon →

Davidoff is a globally renowned luxury brand that has extended its legacy of sophistication and excellence into the world of premium coffee. Inspired by the philosophy of its founder, Zino Davidoff, who believed in the pursuit of the finer things in life, Davidoff Café offers an unparalleled coffee experience for the discerning connoisseur.

The brand is celebrated for its meticulous selection of the finest Arabica beans sourced from the world’s premier coffee-growing regions, including Central and South America, and East Africa. Davidoff’s master blenders carefully roast these beans to perfection, unlocking their complex flavor profiles and captivating aromas.

Their flagship instant coffees, such as the Rich Aroma and Espresso 57, are beloved for their smooth, full-bodied taste and elegant glass jar packaging that exudes luxury. Whether you prefer a robust espresso or a delicate, aromatic cup, Davidoff Café delivers a consistently premium experience that elevates the everyday coffee ritual.

With its unwavering commitment to quality and craftsmanship, Davidoff remains a symbol of refined taste and a top choice for coffee lovers seeking a touch of everyday luxury.

Notable fact: Associated with the luxury lifestyle brand Zino Davidoff.

5. Rage Coffee

Check price on Amazon →

Rage Coffee is a fast-growing, innovative Indian coffee brand that has disrupted the traditional coffee market with its unique blend of great taste and functional benefits. Founded in 2018 by Bharat Sethi, the brand was created to cater to the modern, active consumer who seeks more than just a caffeine kick from their daily cup.

Rage Coffee stands out by infusing its premium 100% Arabica coffee with plant-based vitamins and natural extracts, offering a sustained energy boost without the typical caffeine crash or jitters.

The brand has gained a massive following for its wide array of delicious, flavored instant coffees, ranging from Irish Hazelnut and Dark Chocolate to Butterscotch Delight, all crafted without any artificial additives or bitter aftertaste.

Beyond instant coffee, Rage has expanded its product line to include liquid coffee decoctions, cold brew bags, and ground coffee, all packaged in eye-catching, vibrant containers.

With a strong emphasis on quality sourcing, innovative formulations, and a bold brand persona, Rage Coffee has successfully carved out a niche for itself as a lifestyle brand that energizes and inspires a new generation of coffee enthusiasts.

Notable fact: Infused with plant vitamins for sustained energy.

6. Nescafe

Check price on Amazon →

Nescafé, a flagship brand of the Swiss multinational Nestlé, is arguably the most recognized and widely consumed coffee brand in the world. Launched in 1938 after years of research to create a high-quality instant coffee that simply required the addition of hot water, Nescafé revolutionized global coffee consumption.

In India, Nescafé has been a household name for decades, synonymous with the quintessential morning cup of coffee. The brand’s classic offering, Nescafé Classic, is beloved for its unmistakable rich aroma and robust flavor, achieved through a careful selection and roasting of coffee beans.

Catering to a diverse range of preferences, Nescafé has continuously innovated its product portfolio, introducing premium variants like Nescafé Gold, which features freeze-dried granules for a smoother, cafe-style experience, as well as an array of ready-to-drink cold coffees and specialized blends like Black Roast.

Nescafé’s enduring popularity is rooted in its commitment to quality, its massive global supply chain that ensures consistency, and its deep connection with consumers through memorable marketing campaigns. As a pioneer in the industry, Nescafé continues to shape coffee culture, making a great cup of coffee accessible to everyone, everywhere.

Notable fact: One of the first successful instant coffees in the world.

7. Continental

Check price on Amazon →

Continental Coffee is a prominent Indian coffee brand that has rapidly gained popularity for delivering exceptional quality and authentic flavors at accessible prices. Backed by CCL Products (India) Limited, one of the world’s largest private label coffee manufacturers, Continental benefits from decades of expertise in coffee sourcing, blending, and roasting.

The brand offers a diverse portfolio designed to cater to the varied palates of Indian consumers. Their Continental Xtra is a widely loved instant coffee blend that combines coffee and chicory for a strong, robust cup, while their premium freeze-dried offerings provide a smooth, cafe-like experience.

Continental has also made a significant mark with its ‘Malgudi’ range, which pays homage to the traditional South Indian filter coffee, offering an aromatic and deeply satisfying brew. The brand’s commitment to quality control from bean to cup ensures a consistent and superior product.

With its expanding distribution network and focus on authentic taste profiles, Continental Coffee continues to challenge established players and win the loyalty of coffee aficionados across the country, celebrating the rich coffee heritage of India.

Notable fact: Backed by one of the largest coffee manufacturers, CCL Products.

8. Vedaka

Check price on Amazon →

Vedaka is a private label brand owned by Amazon India, dedicated to providing high-quality, everyday grocery and pantry staples at competitive prices. As part of its extensive product range, Vedaka has ventured into the coffee segment, offering reliable and flavorful options for the daily coffee drinker.

The brand focuses on delivering consistent quality and value for money, making it a popular choice for budget-conscious consumers who do not want to compromise on taste. Vedaka’s coffee portfolio includes classic instant coffee blends, often featuring a mix of coffee and chicory to provide a strong, robust flavor that appeals to the Indian palate.

Additionally, they offer authentic South Indian filter coffee powders and convenient liquid decoctions, catering to traditional tastes. Sourced and manufactured under strict quality control standards, Vedaka ensures that every pack meets the expectations of its customers.

Leveraging Amazon’s massive reach and efficient delivery network, Vedaka has successfully established itself as a trusted and accessible household brand, offering a satisfying cup of coffee that fits seamlessly into the daily routine of millions of Indians.

Notable fact: Amazon’s in-house grocery brand.

9. Tata Coffee

Check price on Amazon →

Tata Coffee, a subsidiary of Tata Consumer Products, is one of the most respected and established names in the Indian coffee industry, boasting a rich heritage that dates back to 1922.

As one of the largest integrated coffee companies in the world, Tata Coffee manages vast estates across South India, giving them unparalleled control over the entire coffee-making process, from cultivation to the final product. This deep-rooted expertise is reflected in their popular consumer brands, most notably Tata Coffee Grand.

Known for its innovative approach, Tata Coffee Grand features unique flavor-locked decoction crystals combined with agglomerated coffee, delivering a rich aroma and a superior, cafe-like taste at home. The brand also offers premium variants like Tata Coffee Gold, an exquisite freeze-dried coffee made from carefully selected Arabica and Robusta beans.

Beyond its consumer products, Tata Coffee is a major exporter of green beans and instant coffee globally. With a strong commitment to sustainable farming practices and community development, Tata Coffee not only produces exceptional blends but also upholds the ethical values synonymous with the Tata Group, making it a trusted choice for millions.

Notable fact: Owns some of the largest coffee estates in Asia.

10. Moccona

Check price on Amazon →

Moccona is a prestigious international coffee brand with a rich European heritage that traces its roots back to 1753 in the Netherlands, originally founded by the renowned Douwe Egberts company. Known for its uncompromising quality and sophisticated flavor profiles, Moccona has become a symbol of premium instant coffee across the globe.

The brand is instantly recognizable by its iconic, elegant cylindrical glass jar with a distinctive glass stopper, designed to preserve the coffee’s rich aroma and freshness. Moccona’s coffee is crafted from a meticulous blend of the finest Arabica and Robusta beans, which are expertly roasted and freeze-dried to capture their full-bodied flavor and smooth finish.

Their Classic Medium Roast is a beloved staple, offering a perfectly balanced and aromatic cup, while their Dark Roast caters to those who prefer a more intense and bold coffee experience.

Moccona’s dedication to the art of coffee making provides a luxurious, cafe-quality experience in the comfort of one’s home. It remains a top choice for coffee aficionados who appreciate the finer details and a consistently exquisite taste in every cup.

Notable fact: Famous for its iconic airtight glass jar.

11. VS Mani & Co

Check price on Amazon →

VS Mani & Co is a charming and nostalgic Indian brand dedicated to bringing the authentic flavors and warm hospitality of a traditional South Indian home to consumers across the country.

Founded in 2020 by GD Prasad, Rahul Bajaj, and Yashas Alur, the brand is a heartfelt tribute to the founder’s grandparents and the quintessential Madras filter coffee experience.

VS Mani & Co specializes in high-quality, ready-to-use filter coffee decoctions, allowing anyone to enjoy a perfect, frothy cup of traditional South Indian coffee in seconds, without the need for specialized brewing equipment. Their decoctions are made from carefully sourced Arabica and Robusta beans, expertly roasted and blended with chicory to achieve the signature strong aroma and full-bodied taste.

Beyond coffee, the brand has expanded its offerings to include classic South Indian snacks and instant coffee blends, all packaged with a delightful retro aesthetic. With its focus on convenience, uncompromising authenticity, and a strong emotional connection to cultural roots, VS Mani & Co has quickly captured the hearts of consumers seeking a genuine and comforting taste of South India.

Notable fact: A tribute to traditional South Indian coffee culture.

12. Impulse Coffees

Check price on Amazon →

Impulse Coffees is an exciting and vibrant emerging brand in the Indian D2C coffee space, designed to cater to the adventurous palates of modern coffee drinkers. Launched with a focus on creating a fun, aesthetic, and highly enjoyable coffee experience, the brand has quickly gained attention for its unique and indulgent flavor profiles.

Impulse Coffees specializes in premium flavored instant coffees, offering a delightful range of options that often draw inspiration from popular desserts and treats. From rich mocha and creamy caramel to more inventive seasonal blends, their products are crafted to provide a cafe-style flavored coffee experience right at home, without the need for added syrups or sugars.

The brand places a strong emphasis on high-quality sourcing, using premium beans to ensure a smooth and robust base for their creative flavors. With its highly “Instagrammable” packaging, engaging brand persona, and convenient formats like single-serve sachets, Impulse Coffees appeals strongly to younger demographics and anyone looking to add a touch of excitement and variety to their daily coffee routine.

Notable fact: Known for highly aesthetic packaging and dessert flavors.

Conclusion

From mass-market staples like Bru and Nescafé to premium innovators like Sleepy Owl, Rage Coffee, and VAHDAM-style experiences, India’s coffee market offers exceptional variety. Use the comparison table above to shortlist brands by budget and taste, then explore the detailed profiles to find your perfect brew.

This post contains affiliate links. As an Amazon Associate, we earn from qualifying purchases. This does not affect our editorial independence.
