Pharmaceutical Companies at Bangalore:- Do you know, Pharmaceutical Industry in India is among the Biggest pharma industries in the world. It ranks 4th in the world, pertaining to the volume of sales.

The hub of pharma companies in India is in Bangalore city. Bangalore has always been seen as a pioneer, whether it is about manufacturing pharmaceutical products or exporting them to foreign countries.

Most of the pharma companies in Bengaluru are among the largest pharma companies in India.

The setups of Pharma Companies in this city are growing very fast and today its figure has crossed 150+ Pharmaceutical companies in Bangalore.

There will be no wrong if we say it as the center of pharma companies in India.

With this article, we will go through the list of Top 10 Pharmaceutical Companies at Bangalore. Thus, you will get to know about the 10 best Pharma Companies in Bangalore.

Currently, all these companies are working on providing better healthcare services to our country. So let’s start with the topic of the Top 10 Pharma Companies in Bangalore.

Top 10 Pharmaceutical Companies at Bangalore

1. Biocon Ltd

Biocon Limited began its journey in 1978 as a joint venture with Biocon Biochemicals Ltd.

They had the vision to make India independent and self-sufficient in the manufacturing of nutrition healthcare products.

The company is one of the best pharmaceutical companies at Bangalore.

The first major achievement of this company is to be the first company in India who manufacture and export enzymes to the USA and Europe.  Apart from this, this company created the first biosimilar Insulin Glargine pen in Japan.

They are globally recognized in providing advanced therapies for chronic diseases, where medical needs are largely unmet and the cost of treatment is also high.

Papain an enzyme found in papaya which is used to prevent beer from turning vague was the first launched product.

Following are some other main interventions: –

  • 2013: -They launched a biologic drug ALZUMAb to treat psoriasis.
  • 2014: -Invented the world’s first biosimilar drug CANMAb to treat breast cancer.
  • 2015: Launched hepatitis-C in the Indian market under the brand name CIMIVIR.

More than 9,200+ people are engaged in the working slots in about 120 countries. At the present time, the reins of this company are with Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw.

He is the founder as well as the current chairman of the company.

Specification

    2. Strides Pharma

    To begin with, Strides Pharma is a Pvt Limited company that was founded in 1990 by Arun Kumar.

    The company has its share listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange and the National Stock Exchange of India.

    Strides pharma is commonly named among the top pharmaceutical companies at Bangalore.

    Over the years, it has grown tremendously in this industry. The company is backed by research and developmental activities.

    The head office of this company is in Bangalore, India. There are seven manufacturing facilities including four US FDA-approved facilities.

    The company also has an in-house R&D infrastructure in Bengaluru, India.

    Dedicated and experienced professionals engaged in their R&D department facilitating their services in India and has a strong footprint across 100 countries.

    Mainly, they focus on the manufacturing of IP-led niche finished dosage formulations.

    Products manufactured by the company

    • General Tablets,
    • Sachets,
    • Ointments,
    • Soft and Hard Gelatin Capsules
    • Liquids [Oral Liquids)
    • Topicals [Ointment & Cream] and Powders

    The company is serving an exhaustive pipeline of generics drugs. They are among the leading players in the production of soft gel capsules.

    All the products written above are supplied in countries like Italy and the US.

    Specification

    3. Beckman Coulter

    The company has completed more than 80 years of serving better healthcare solutions to society.

    Established in 1935 as National Technical Laboratories to commercialize a pH meter, invented by  Caltech professor Arnold O. Beckman.

    This Pharmacy is among the best pharmaceutical companies at Bangalore.

    The company eventually grew a lot and today it has a strong team of over 12,000 people. It has its corporate head office in California, United States.

    More than 11,000 global associates are working diligently and with a selfless spirit to make the world a healthier place. Its balance sheet of 2017 shows a turnover of $ 5.8 billion for the entire year

    In 2011, Danaher Corporation took over Beckman Coulter. The company is engaged in developing, manufacturing, and marketing products.

    Thus, they simplify, automates, and innovates complex biomedical testing. It is operating in two sections: Diagnostics and Life Sciences.

    They have a diagnostic system for complex biomedical testing. In brief, the company is committed to advance better healthcare solutions, applying the power of science and technology.

    Specification

    4. Covance Pharmaceutical

    Covance begins operations as an independent entity and a publicly Limited company. It is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE).

    The company is one of the best pharmaceutical companies at Bangalore.

    Covance is a contract research organization (CRO) offering nonclinical, preclinical, clinical, and commercialization services to pharmaceutical and biotechnology industries.

    The company is headquartered in Princeton, New Jersey. Initially, they started as Environmental Sciences Corporation.

    Later In 1997, the business merged into a publicly traded company, after being spun off by Corning which was started in 1996.

    Reins to run this company are with LabCorp (an American company) who is employing more than 50,000 people in over 60 countries.

    The company is deriving huge profits having annual revenues of over $2 billion. Looking at all these, we can call this company one of the biggest pharmaceutical companies at Bangalore. 

    They claim to have the world’s largest central laboratory network. In 2018, LabCorp the holding of Covance was rated one of the best places to work by the Human Rights Campaign.

    The company uses animals to test their drugs and other chemical inventions.

    As a contract testing facility, Covance is essentially a laboratory to conduct a test on any animal for the right price. Due to this, they had to face a lot of criticism for violating animal rights.

    As part of its clinical and non-clinical development services, They offer drug development services across all phases of development and multiple pharmaceutical areas.

    Therapeutic areas served by the company

    • Cardiovascular, diabetes,
    • Endocrinology and nephrology, 
    • Immuno-oncology,
    • Infectious diseases and inflammation, 
    • Neuroscience, non-alcoholic steatohepatitis (NASH), 
    • Oncology, rare diseases, pediatrics, and the development of companion diagnostics.

    Specification

    5. Mylan Pharma

    Mylan is one of the global pharmaceutical companies in Bangalore providing healthcare services to more than 7 billion people.

    They have a distribution channel of more than 7,500 products in their portfolio.

    This company has a huge market base providing its services in over 165 countries with a dedicated team of 35,000-strong. Began with a sole motto to heal all the sorrows in a person’s life. All they do is entreat better health and healing in society.

    Mylan is a global generic and specialty pharmaceutical company. The company is headquartered in the United States of America.

    In 2007, they entered the Indian pharmaceutical market and acquired Matrix Laboratories Limited. Also, Mylan took over a generics business of Germany-based Merck KGaA.

    After these acquisitions, the company improved its international rankings.

    The company jumped from the third-largest generic and pharmaceutical company in the United States to the second-largest generic and specialty pharmaceutical company in the world.

    Founded in 1961 by Milan Puskar and Don Panoz. The company went public on the OTC market in February 1973. The manufacturing plant of the company is in Bangalore City.

    Mainly, the company is engaged in the production of active pharmaceutical ingredients (API), oral solid dose (OSD), and injectables are manufactured.

    They serve a number of markets around the world and produce a wide range of products in therapeutic areas.

    Therapeutic areas served by the company

    • Oncology, Anaphylaxis,
    • Antiretrovirals, Cardiovascular,
    • Respiratory, Dermatology, Immunology,
    • Anesthesia And Pain Management,
    • Infectious Disease, Gastroenterology,
    • Diabetology/endocrinology, And Women’s Healthcare.

    A team of more than 3000 scientists is working coordinately to provide a solution for unmet medical needs. About half of their scientific operational workforce is based in India.

    In late July 2019, Pfizer agreed to spin off and merge its off-patent medicine division, Upjohn, with Mylan.

    After this, a new company called Viatris came into existence, held as one of Mylan’s subsidiaries. Thus, the company entered into a new pharmaceutical business with sales of around $20 billion.

    Specification

    6. Himalaya

    This is a Bengaluru-based company established by M Manal in 1930. The corporate office of the company is among the top 10 pharmaceutical companies at Bangalore.

    Himalaya is a famous name providing herbal ayurvedic medicine, Nutrition, Personal, and Baby Care products.

    Almost every Indian family uses its products. I know most of you will be familiar with Neem Face Wash of Himalaya. It is one of their most popular and well-known products.

    This company has a broad market in India, besides this, it also supplies its products to 106 countries across the world.

    The research and development team of this company consists of 290 researchers.

    The team advises compositions in the making of ayurvedic and herbal products. In 1955, the company launched a Hepatic drug, named Liv.52. It was the first product in the launch.

    Himalaya Drug Company is the subsidiary of Himalaya Global Holdings Ltd. The main head office of the company is located in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India.

    The founder of this corporation was M Manal. He started the corporation with a vision to commercialize the roots and herbs products being used in natural form earlier.

    As of 2015, the company derives about 50% of its revenue from the international market.

    Specification

    7. Syngene Pharma

    Another common name in this list of top 10 Pharmaceutical companies at Bangalore is Syngene. Began its journey in the production of pharmaceuticals in 1993.

    Biocon Limited is the parent company of Syngene. The company is one of the leading contract research organizations engaged in the manufacturing of pharmaceutical products.

    They have a strong corporate governance framework whose entire focus is on client satisfaction, quality, and safety.

    Leveraging its scientific skills, the company focuses on delivering significant value to the customers.

    In order to qualify international standards, they have a World-class infrastructure spread across 1.5 million sq ft.

    They ensure a safe and sociable working environment for their workers. To safeguard the environment, they adopt environment-friendly measures to reduce waste, controlling pollution, and producing safe products.

    An ISO 9001:2008, ISO 14001:2004 certified, the company promotes extended product lines with the tag Fortune 500.

    Recent Agreement Done By company

    In 2019, they have agreed with the Biotechnology Industry Research Assistance Council (BIRAC), a Government of India undertaking, for installing a Center for Advanced Protein Studies (CAPS)

    Awards

    • India Pharma Award 2019 – For “Excellence in Contract Research and Manufacturing Services” 
    • Utthama Suraksha Puraskar 2019
    • CMO Leadership Awards which was Granted by Life Science Leader Magazine in New York
    • FICCI CSR Award for Environmental Sustainability
    • Safe Workplace Champion Award was given on the occasion of the 8th Manufacturing Supply Chain Summit organized in New Delhi.
    • Best Leadership Development Program for Middle Management Award

    Therapeutic areas served by the company

    • Diabetology, Oncology
    • Rheumatology
    • Infectious diseases
    • Gastroenterology
    • Nephrology and Cardiology
    • Neuropsychiatry and Immunology

    Specification

    8. MEDREICH Ltd

    Another fully integrated pharmaceutical company is Medreich. The corporate office of this company is based in Bangalore.

    The company is one of the biggest pharmaceutical companies at Bangalore.

    It was started in 1976 by Rajeev Mehta, Keith De Souza, and CP Bothra. In 2015, Japanese company Meiji Holdings acquired the company with a total consideration of $290 million.

    Meiji Group is a leading Japanese conglomerate listed on the Tokyo stock exchange. The company’s brand name has not changed post the acquisition.

    They have a dedicated team of professionals which includes 75 scientists, working sincerely in the research and development of products. The company has about 500 products in its portfolio.

    Mainly, the company is engaged in the CMO & CDMO business, Manufacturing pharma products in various dosage forms, and caters to diverse Therapeutic areas. 

    Medreich has a global presence providing its service in India, Spain, and across 55 more countries. The company has 6 manufacturing facilities in India and 1 in Spain.

    They are exclusive manufacturers for Pfizer & GSK. Medreich has advanced state-of-the-art R&D centers with proven scientific competence to develop formulations. Mainly they produce Formulations for Wyeth & Sanofi.

    With more than 3000 employees worldwide, the company is growing fast while providing quality medicines to patients.

    Medreich has the in-house ability to ensure administrative compliance in regulated markets across the globe.

    Specification

    9. Adcock Ingram Ltd

    Adcock Ingram was incorporated as a pharmacy in 1890. This is one of the biggest pharmaceutical companies at Bangalore.

    Initially started its operation under the name EJ Adcock Pharmacy in Krugersdorp, South Africa.

    The company is the only local pharma company providing full-time care by offering pharmaceutical distribution solutions.

    Adcock Ingram is a leading South African pharmaceutical conglomerate, listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange.

    The Company manufactures and markets pharmaceutical healthcare products. Adcock Ingram is one of the leading suppliers for the private and public sectors markets.

    The company is the second-largest manufacturer in the private pharmaceutical market. Also the second largest supplier to the public sector.

    The main area of their operation is to supply antiretroviral (ARV) medicines to the public sector. Adcock Ingram is a committed supplier of significant care products to the public sector and hospitals. 

    Recently, the corporate has undertaken a capital expansion project costing R1.5 billion. The project includes three manufacturing facilities situated in Gauteng.

    Specification

    10. SPI Pharma

    SPI is a fully owned subsidiary of the British Foods company. They are among the worldwide leaders in custom formulation solutions for pharmaceutical manufacturers.

    The company is one of the leading pharmaceutical companies in Bangalore.

    For over 75 years, they are delivering highly engineered pharmaceutical products across the world.

    Working diligently and committed towards the formulation of innovative pharmaceutical products to meet patient needs.

    The company has a full-fledged testing center in Bangalore India. SPI drug Pharma capabilities include Formulation production development and Optimization product prototypes.

    The lab is equipped with state of art formulation equipment. They work on specialty solid oral dosage forms, orally disintegrated tablets and Mini OTC.

    As a global leader, SPI Pharma serves over 55 countries with formulation innovation. The corporate office of the company is situated in Wilmington.

    Jeanne Thoma is an experienced turnaround leader was the founder of the company.

    Specification

    11. Jubilant Drug Discovery and Development Services

    The Jubilant Drug Discovery and Development Services is a superior Pharmaceutical and Research center based in Bangalore that was directly named after Jubilant Life Sciences Limited.

    The company earns a place in the list of the leading pharmaceutical companies in Bangalore this year for its innovative approach in neutralizing hardcore antibiotics for lesser side effects.

    Besides its popularity in Bangalore, it had since established massive counterparts across the globe. It promulgates research methods for drug discoveries in particular medical centers in Asia, North America, and Europe.

    12. Genotypic Technology

    Genotypic Technology is a prominent Pharmaceutical Company based in Bangalore that secures a spot on the list of the biggest pharmaceutical companies in Bangalore.

    The company is ISO 9001: 2008 certified with an enormous production unit in Bangalore. With a superior command in the whole PAN India network, the company holds one of the biggest networks in the world.

    13. Manan Health Care Pvt. Ltd.

    The Manan Health Care Private Limited is a Pharma Company that was established and started in 2010.

    It earns a spot on the list of the major Bangalore pharma companies after four years of trial service.

    Within its very early years of service, the company was able to make good records in the market. Consequently, it was listed as one of the most promising countries in the world.

    The company masters in the production of sophisticated but affordable Cell Enhancement Organic Products which are generally purchased by a number of starting pharma companies in the world.

    15. XCyton

    XCyton Pharmaceutical Company is an excellent benchmark for pharma companies in Bangalore and across the globe. It was established in 1993 and had since held a position in the list of the major Bangalore pharma firms.

    Considered globally as the 11th company with the friendliest products, the company has garnered various awards, certifications, and recognitions throughout the years. A very famous title given to the company is the “Best Bio-Product Award”.

    16. PULSATOM Healthcare

    PULSATOM Healthcare is a prestigious Pharmaceutical Company that was established in the year 1996. Since then, it has secured itself a place in the list of the top 10 Bangalore pharma firms.

    What distinguishes the company from the rest are its visionary aims in totally upgrading the medical technology in Bangalore.

    In the past, this resulted in the company’s creation of the first-ever indigenous Blood Glucose Meter. This kind of meter measures the blood rate very accurately.

    Thanks to the company, this product has been made accessible to a number of economically challenged villagers in Bangalore. The company in turn was openly praised and awarded by various international pharmaceutical sectors after that.

    17. Velbionanotech

    Velbionanotech is another prestigious Pharmaceutical Bangalore-based Company that was established in 2002.

    It had since earned a maintained position in the list of the top 10 Bangalore pharmacy firms. The company owns large-scale production and research units across the globe.

    Powered by its talented and professional team of researchers and medical practitioners, the company eases its way out in discovering the best Kidney Stones, Hypertension, and Heart Disease treatment methods.

    18. Span Healthcare Pvt. Ltd.

    The Span Healthcare Private Limited is a Bangalore-based Pharmaceutical Company that holds a place in the list of the top Bangalore pharmacy firms.

    Having produced the most affordable medical products across Bangalore and the world, the company declares earlier this year its largest client-based record of over 60 million products manufactured a year.

    On the side, the company affiliates with international firms for research projects and other healthcare events. Finally, the company’s products had been used widely by 200 hospitals across India.

    19. Camson Bio Technologies Ltd.

    The Camson Bio Technologies Limited is a Banglore-based Pharma company that leads the market in the production of Agri-Biotech products through world-class research methods.

    The company is responsible for the release of massive high-quality Biocide products in the international market.

    Nevertheless, the company has forever left a mark of victory in the list of the top 10 Bangalore pharmacy industries when it refurnished the farming industry by producing 1000+ varieties of natural fertilizers and further expanding farmers’ options between natural and chemical fertilizers.

    Wrapping up the list of top 10 Pharmaceutical Companies in Bangalore. Comment below your personal favorite pharmacy. Provide valuable feedback on the article.

Best EPC Companies in Chennai: In today’s business landscape, companies must go beyond simply selling products or services—they must focus on delivering added value. The effectiveness of any EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) company is often measured by its operating profits, market capitalization, and the number of projects successfully completed.

Return on Investment (ROI) is a key metric businesses use to evaluate how efficiently they are using capital to generate long-term profits. The best EPC companies in Chennai help you enhance your business’s long-term profitability through strategic energy and infrastructure solutions.

An EPC company partners with organizations to improve energy performance, resulting in significant cost savings. If you’re looking to identify some of the top EPC companies in Chennai, this article will guide you. We’ve compiled a curated list of the top 10 EPC firms in the city to help you make an informed decision.

Best EPC Companies in Chennai

1. Afcons Infrastructure

AFCONS Infrastructure Limited (AFCONS) is the flagship civil engineering and construction company of the 150-year-old Shapoorji Pallonji Group. Established in 1980, the company is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

AFCONS specializes in executing large and complex infrastructure projects both in India and internationally. Over the past five years, it has received numerous awards from various countries and leading multinational clients for successfully delivering technically challenging projects.

The company offers infrastructure services across a broad range of sectors, including marine works, roads, bridges, subways, tunnels, and onshore and offshore oil and gas platforms. AFCONS has established a global footprint and is recognized among the world’s top ten companies in the shipping infrastructure sector, known for its engineering excellence, quality standards, and timely project completion.

As of 2022, AFCONS operates in 29 countries and employs over 4,600 professionals. Financially, the company reported a Profit After Tax (PAT) of ₹166.97 Crores in 2021, with a total income of ₹9,521.13 Crores. The company’s P/E ratio stands at 17.21, and its market capitalization was approximately ₹213 Crores in 2022.

AFCONS has been recognized as the fastest-growing construction company in the main category and one of India’s most respected construction companies by Construction World magazine for eight consecutive years. It is certified under ISO 9001:2015 for Quality Management, ISO 14001:2015, and ISO 45001:2018 for Occupational Health, Safety, and Environmental Management Systems.

Contact and Location

  • Address: Plot No: 1633, H-Block, 1st floor, 13 Main Road, Anna Nagar (West), Chennai – 600 040
  • FAX: +91-22-2673 0047/ 2673 0026
  • Phone: +91-22-6719 1000
  • Email: bd@afcons.com

2. Technip FMC

TechnipFMC is a global leader in technology and engineering services for the energy industry. Originally founded in 1958 and headquartered in Paris, France, the company underwent a significant transformation and officially became TechnipFMC in 2017 following the merger of Technip and FMC Technologies.

TechnipFMC delivers a wide range of services including project management, engineering, and construction, primarily for the oil and gas sector. With operations in 48 countries, the company employs more than 38,500 people worldwide.

As of 2022, TechnipFMC has a market capitalization of $3.92 billion, ranking it as the 2675th most valuable company in the world. The company generated $6.19 billion in revenue during the 2022 fiscal year, with earnings of $51.4 million. Its price-to-earnings (P/E) ratio currently stands at -15.9, reflecting a negative earnings performance.

Technip has a strong legacy in the financial markets. In the 1990s, it was listed on the Paris Stock Exchange, while Coflexip, a key acquisition, was listed on the New York Stock Exchange. In 2009, Technip became part of the CAC 40, France’s benchmark stock index, further cementing its reputation as a major player in the global energy sector.

Contact and Location

  • Address: 19, Velachery Rd, Guindy National Park, Guindy, Chennai, Tamil Nadu
  • Metro: Guindy Metro 0.91km
  • Phone: +91 44 2230 3100
  • Email: phema@technip.com

3. NRP Projects

Another one of the Best EPC companies in India is the NPR project. It is a Private Limited Firm. The company was formerly known as N.R. Patel & Company. 

NPR project got incorporated in 1964. It started as a small engineering construction company in Bangalore, South India. The head of the company is in Chennai, Tamil Nadu. Mr. Naginbhai R. Patel & Mr. Jayantibhai R. Patel was the company’s founder.

The current director of the company is Shailesh Patel. The total workforce of a company is between 200 to 500. The average turnover of the company is $11.1 Million. The market cap of the company as of 2002 is $12.5 Million. NRP is one of the leading ISO Certified engineering construction companies in India. The company offers the following services for the oil and gas industry.

  • Integrated design, 
  • Detailed engineering, 
  • Procurement, 
  • Construction and project management services 

The Company’s financial budget is supported by its connected banker, i.e., M/s. Union Bank of India. The Company has no outstanding loans and maintains a creditworthiness image with banks.

Contact and Location

  • Location: Deshabandhu Plaza, #47, Whites Road, Royapettah, Chennai 600 014, INDIA.
  • Phone: +91 44 2859 4601 (30 Lines)
  • Fax: +91 44 2859 4629
  • Email: piping@nrpprojects.in

4. Enmas India

Enmas India is one of the leading EPC companies in India. It is a private unlisted company and is classified as a company limited by shares. Founded in 2013, the company has multiplied and has 2000+ employees. The head office of the company is in Chennai, Tamil Nadu.

The company’s authorized share capital is 100 lakhs, and its paid-up capital is 42.2 lakhs. The average annual sale turnover of the company is between 5 to 7 crores rupees. The company has no global presence and has operations only in India.

The CIN number of the company is U40105TN2005PTC056827, and its registered number is 56827. The current managing director of the company is Mr. L Venkadasamy.

Contact and Location

  • Location: EOM SQUARE, SP 107, Ambattur Industrial Estate, Ambattur, Chennai – 600058, Tamil Nadu, India.
  • Mobile: + 91 44 3000 3888

5. RSN Engineering

RSN Engineering and Construction (RSNECC) is one of the best EPC companies in Chennai. The company was incorporated on 08 May 2012. The company has a global presence in 4 countries, including Qatar, Malaysia, Saudi Arabia, and Canada. The total workforce of the company as per socials(LinkedIn) is between 51-200 people.

The company also serves an additional workforce for ongoing EPC works. RSN Engineering provides the following services in the engineering category:-

  • Civil structure engineering
  • Electrical engineering

title.rendered: Top 30 IT Staffing Companies in USA (Updated-List)

content.rendered:
In today’s competitive business landscape, finding the right IT talent is crucial for organizational success. The global IT staffing market, valued at $184.64 billion in 2024, is projected to grow to $137.3 billion by 2028—a clear indicator of the increasing reliance on staffing companies for workforce solutions.

Partnering with an IT staffing company not only streamlines the hiring process but also offers significant cost savings, with businesses cutting recruitment expenses by up to 60% compared to traditional hiring methods.

These firms specialize in sourcing skilled tech professionals, ensuring you have access to the best talent for your needs. However, choosing the right IT staffing partner in the USA is essential to achieve these benefits. In this article, we explore the top IT staffing companies that have consistently delivered reliable, cost-effective solutions to help businesses thrive in a technology-driven world.

Best IT Staffing Companies in USA

1. Toptal (Freelancer Network)

If you’re looking for top-notch freelance IT professionals, Toptal is the place to go. They carefully select the top 3% of IT talent worldwide, ensuring you work with the best in the industry. With flexible hiring options and quick project delivery, they help you get started fast.

Toptal is known for its smooth onboarding process, clear pricing, and dedicated account managers, making them a trusted choice for many clients. Whether you need help with a short-term task or require specialized skills, Toptal has you covered.

Based in San Francisco, Toptal is one of the largest and most respected IT staffing firms in the USA, with services reaching clients globally. Initially focused on software, app, and web development, they now offer a wide range of freelance experts, including designers, finance professionals, and project managers. With over 6,000 employees, Toptal is a go-to platform for businesses seeking skilled professionals.

2. Robert Half 

Robert Half is a trusted name in IT staffing, with decades of experience and a strong reputation for connecting businesses with skilled IT professionals. They have an extensive network of branch offices and a large pool of candidates, making it easy to find the right talent quickly. Whether you need temporary, contract-to-hire, or permanent placements, Robert Half is known for its efficient and reliable services.

Founded in 1948 by Bob and Maxine Half, Robert Half is one of the oldest IT staffing companies in the USA. For 25 years in a row, it has been recognized as one of Fortune’s most admired companies. While specializing in IT staffing, they also provide talent for industries like finance, administration, legal, and marketing. With regional offices worldwide, Robert Half offers global reach and local expertise.

Headquartered in Menlo Park, CA, Robert Half employs around 14,600 people and generates an annual revenue of $7.24 billion.

3. Express Employment Professionals

Express Employment Professionals is a well-known IT staffing agency with a presence in over 700 locations worldwide. They offer a variety of staffing solutions, including contract, direct placement, and both short- and long-term staffing options. In addition to the USA, they have offices in Canada, New Zealand, and Australia, making them a global player in the staffing industry.

The company connects job seekers with employers across multiple industries, specializing in administrative, commercial, and industrial roles. Their expertise in matching candidates with the right jobs helps businesses find qualified talent efficiently. Headquartered at 9701 Boardwalk Blvd, Oklahoma City, OK, Express Employment Professionals employs around 9,459 people and is recognized for its commitment to helping businesses and job seekers thrive.

4. Randstad Technologies

Randstad is a leading IT staffing firm in the US, with over 4,800 offices in more than 40 countries. As the world’s second-largest HR service provider, Randstad has been connecting businesses with skilled talent since its founding in 1960, making it one of the most established firms in the industry. Known for its proven track record, Randstad helps companies gain a competitive edge by sourcing proficient and experienced professionals.

Randstad Technologies combines the global reach of a staffing giant with the personalized service of a boutique agency. They offer customized IT staffing solutions, whether you need to scale up for large projects or fill specialized roles. Their extensive database and proactive sourcing approach ensure businesses get the right IT talent quickly and efficiently.

Headquartered in Pleasanton, CA, Randstad employs approximately 653,300 people globally and generates an impressive annual revenue of $30 billion.

5. Adecco 

Adecco is a global leader in IT staffing, known for its extensive experience and commitment to diversity and inclusion. With over three decades of expertise, Adecco provides tailored staffing solutions and access to a vast international talent pool. Whether you need full-time employees, temporary staff, or project-based placements, Adecco’s reach and expertise ensure they can meet your specific needs efficiently.

Operating in more than 60 countries, Adecco has connected over 3.5 million people to job opportunities and serves as a trusted partner for businesses worldwide. They are proud members of organizations such as the National Minority Supplier Development Council, Women’s Business Enterprise National Council, and the Elite Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Business Network.

As the world’s second-largest HR provider, Adecco connects over 700,000 people to jobs daily across various industries. With 32,000 employees and an annual revenue of $25.51 billion, Adecco remains a powerhouse in the staffing world.

6. Tek Systems

TEKsystems is a global leader in IT staffing, talent management, and services, deploying over 80,000 IT professionals annually to help businesses achieve their goals. Headquartered in Hanover, MD, TEKsystems operates in the Internet Software & Services industry and generates an impressive annual revenue of $13.4 billion. With a presence in more than 100 locations and seven solution centers worldwide, they cater to over 6,000 clients, including 80% of Fortune 500 companies.

TEKsystems is highly regarded for its expertise in emerging technologies and digital transformation projects. Their dedicated recruiting teams specialize in cutting-edge fields such as application development, cybersecurity, and network infrastructure. Whether you need contract staffing or direct-hire placements, they offer flexible solutions tailored to your needs.

With a proven track record and strong relationships with industry giants, TEKsystems supports businesses of all sizes, from startups to global enterprises, delivering skilled professionals and ensuring client satisfaction.

7. Kforce 

Kforce is a Florida-based IT staffing firm with a strong focus on technology and finance, connecting over 35,000 professionals to 4,000 companies annually. Founded in 1962, Kforce brings decades of experience, helping businesses find skilled talent through its extensive network. Known for its efficiency and flexibility, Kforce specializes in temporary and contract-to-hire placements, making it a top choice for companies with short-term or project-based staffing needs.

The company prides itself on understanding the industries it serves, ensuring a perfect match between candidates’ skills and organizational culture. Kforce’s streamlined placement process and nationwide reach have made it a favorite among businesses seeking cost-effective staffing solutions.

Recognized for its excellence, Kforce earned a spot in the top five of Forbes’ 2017 America’s Best Professional Recruiting Firms list. Headquartered in Tampa, FL, with approximately 2,000 employees, Kforce generates an annual revenue of $1.1 billion and continues to deliver innovative staffing solutions.

8. Insight Global 

Insight Global is a leading IT staffing firm known for its speed, efficiency, and personalized service. Based in Atlanta, GA, the company specializes in contract and contract-to-hire placements, offering flexible engagement models and quick turnaround times. With an extensive network of branch offices across the U.S., Insight Global has built a strong reputation for connecting businesses with highly qualified IT professionals.

The company prides itself on its vibrant culture, client-focused approach, and commitment to fostering long-term relationships. Beyond staffing, Insight Global emphasizes the professional development of the candidates it places, ensuring mutual success for both employers and employees.

Operating within the professional services industry, Insight Global employs around 3,500 people and provides tailored solutions to meet diverse workforce needs. Their dedication to client satisfaction makes them a trusted partner for IT staffing and consulting services.

9. Aerotek

Aerotek is a global staffing agency recognized for its expertise in industries like aerospace, automotive, and engineering. However, it has also established a strong reputation in IT staffing, offering flexible staffing solutions and direct-hire placements tailored to meet the unique needs of both clients and candidates.

Known for its people-focused approach, Aerotek emphasizes building strong relationships to ensure the right fit for every position. This commitment to understanding individual requirements has made it a trusted partner for businesses seeking skilled IT professionals.

Headquartered in Hanover, MD, Aerotek connects top talent with employers across various industries. With a team of approximately 3,500 employees and a reputation for award-winning customer service, Aerotek stands out as a reliable choice for hiring and career opportunities.

10. CyberCoders

CyberCoders is a leading tech staffing firm that excels in connecting top talent with employers through advanced technology and a team of experienced recruiters. Their proprietary matching system simplifies the hiring process, ensuring swift placements for tech-focused roles. With a vast network of job seekers, CyberCoders is a go-to solution for companies looking to find the most qualified professionals quickly.

Specializing in permanent placements, CyberCoders combines innovative tools with the expertise of over 350 recruiters to deliver efficient and effective staffing services across various industries. Headquartered in Irvine, CA, the company employs approximately 1,250 people and is well-regarded for its speed and reliability in recruitment.

11. Apex Systems

Apex Systems is a tech-focused professional staffing and services firm that helps businesses meet their staffing needs with skilled IT professionals. Catering to Fortune 500 and mid-market clients, the company offers a range of staffing solutions, including contract, permanent, and temp-to-perm placements.

Known for its strong commitment to client satisfaction, Apex Systems ensures businesses find the right talent for their unique needs. In addition to staffing, the company provides digital solutions, technology consulting, and workforce management services.

Headquartered in Glen Allen, VA, Apex Systems employs around 3,500 people and is a trusted name in the Internet Software & Services industry. Their expertise and client-focused approach have made them a reliable partner for businesses seeking top IT talent and innovative solutions.

12. Experis

Experis, a part of the ManpowerGroup family, is a leading IT staffing agency that focuses on providing highly skilled IT professionals for complex projects requiring specialized expertise. They offer a variety of services, including contract staffing and managed services, designed to help businesses find the right talent quickly and efficiently.

With deep knowledge of the tech industry and a vast global network, Experis excels at connecting businesses with top-tier IT professionals, whether for project-based work or permanent placements. Their commitment to quality and client satisfaction makes them a trusted partner for companies looking to drive innovation and growth.

Headquartered in Milwaukee, WI, Experis operates within the Internet Software & Services industry and employs around 30,000 people. With an annual revenue of approximately $21.99 billion, Experis is a global leader in IT staffing and workforce solutions, helping businesses meet their evolving technology and workforce needs.

13. Kelly Services

Kelly Services, a well-established leader in workforce solutions with over 70 years of experience, operates an IT division that connects skilled IT professionals with the right career opportunities. The company offers a variety of staffing services, including contract, contract-to-hire, and full-time positions, catering to roles from support technicians to high-level IT consultants.

Headquartered in Troy, MI, Kelly Services serves multiple industries, including IT, finance, and engineering. The company employs approximately 7,400 people and has an annual revenue of around $4.52 billion. As a global workforce solutions provider, Kelly Services is known for its dedication to matching talented professionals with organizations in need of expertise, helping businesses thrive across various sectors.

14. VACO

VACO is known for focusing on niche IT specialties and building long-term relationships with both clients and candidates. They stand out for their commitment to diversity and inclusion and take the time to thoroughly understand your technical needs. VACO excels in filling roles in areas like cybersecurity, blockchain, and machine learning, using a highly collaborative and personalized approach to find the perfect fit for each position.

As a professional services firm, VACO offers a range of talent solutions, including direct hire staffing, executive search services, contract staffing, and managed services. Located in Brentwood, TN, VACO specializes in industries such as accounting, finance, technology, and healthcare. The company employs around 20 people and is dedicated to providing top-tier talent solutions for businesses across various sectors.

15. The NineHertz

The NineHertz is a prominent IT staffing company established in 2008, known for its expertise in sourcing top-tier IT professionals, digital marketing staff, and software developers.

Leveraging its own workforce of over 250 employees, the firm has developed a comprehensive understanding of recruitment processes, ensuring an optimal match between candidates and client requirements. By employing both online platforms and offline networks, The NineHertz excels in finding skilled professionals adept in various technologies and frameworks.

Headquartered in Atlanta, GA, The NineHertz specializes in IT consulting, custom software development, and a wide array of app, web, and game solutions. It serves a global clientele, including Fortune 500 companies, and employs approximately 330 individuals. Operating within the Internet Software & Services sector, the company is recognized for its proficiency in e-commerce, software development, and professional services.

  • Area of specialists- IT staff, digital marketing experts, software developers, management roles, finance, design & creative, and many other staffing solutions.
  • Based in- Atlanta, USA
  • Website-theninehertz.com

16. Hire with Near

HireWithNear, based in Austin, TX, specializes in connecting U.S. businesses with top-tier tech professionals from Latin America through a proven nearshoring model. By leveraging talent from similar time zones, HireWithNear offers companies high-quality, experienced professionals at competitive salary expectations without compromising on expertise or performance.

Known for its efficiency, HireWithNear streamlines the hiring process to help build high-performing teams in under 21 days. Whether you need remote professionals for a project or long-term positions, their approach focuses on speed and quality, ensuring open roles are filled effectively.

17. The Judge Group

The Judge Group has been in business for over 50 years, offering services like staffing, direct hiring, and consulting. They stand out by combining a large database of candidates with industry expertise to meet each client’s specific needs.

They specialize in legal technology and eDiscovery, making them a go-to for finding skilled IT professionals in the legal field. With strong connections to law firms and corporations, they provide customized solutions for legal tech roles.

The Judge Group prioritizes confidentiality, security, and building long-term relationships, making them a trusted partner in the legal industry. Whether you need temporary staff, contract-to-hire, or permanent hires, they deliver the right talent for the job.

18. ManpowerGroup

ManpowerGroup, based in Milwaukee, WI, is a global leader in workforce solutions. Every day, they connect over 600,000 people with job opportunities through staffing, recruitment, and consulting services. With about 30,000 employees and annual revenue of $20.7 billion, they are a major player in the Human Resource and Employment Services industry.

Their IT staffing services stand out for their wide range of solutions, from temporary staffing to full IT outsourcing. With a massive talent pool and global network, they can quickly find the right candidates for any role, whether short-term or long-term.

ManpowerGroup is also known for its dedication to diversity, inclusion, and sustainability, making them a great choice for businesses that value social responsibility.

19. Collabera

Collabera, based in Basking Ridge, NJ, has been a trusted IT staffing and services provider since 1991. They specialize in IT consulting, talent solutions, and career development, serving Fortune 500 companies and mid-size businesses across various industries and technologies.

With a client-focused approach and a vast network of skilled candidates, Collabera excels in filling contract, contract-to-hire, and full-time positions. The company employs about 16,000 people and reports annual revenue of $856 million, making it a leader in the digital talent solutions space.

Collabera’s strong industry expertise and dedication to meeting client needs make them a reliable partner for organizations seeking top IT talent.

20. PrideStaff

PrideStaff, based in Fresno, CA, is a nationally recognized staffing agency known for providing tailored workforce solutions across various industries, including IT. With nearly 2,000 employees, they specialize in temporary staffing, recruiting services, and connecting businesses with skilled professionals.

PrideStaff is dedicated to excellent service and building long-term relationships with clients. They excel in finding top IT talent for both short-term contracts and permanent roles. Their innovative approach and broad national presence make them a trusted partner for employers looking to strengthen their teams.

21. Mondo

Mondo, based in New York, NY, is a top-tier staffing agency known for its focus on high-end IT, tech, and digital marketing roles. They have a vast candidate network of over 1.4 million and specialize in filling niche, high-demand positions in creative technology and digital marketing.

With a reputation for tailored solutions, Mondo stands out for its ability to source top talent for specialized roles. Their expertise and focus on quality make them a go-to choice for businesses seeking skilled professionals in these dynamic fields.

23. Modis (Akkodis)

Akkodis (formerly Modis) is a global leader in the tech and engineering sectors, offering strategic staffing solutions to meet the needs of businesses worldwide. Known for blending IT and engineering expertise, Akkodis connects companies with top talent for contract, contract-to-hire, and permanent positions.

With a presence in 30 countries and a workforce of around 50,000 experts, Akkodis specializes in areas like mobility, robotics, AI, and software. Their ability to align talent with both technical requirements and company culture sets them apart. Businesses trust Akkodis for its global reach, innovation-driven approach, and commitment to delivering skilled professionals tailored to project needs.

24. Queen Consulting Group

Queen Consulting Group (Now Talent Group) specializes in connecting exceptional tech talent with top job opportunities through tailored staffing solutions, including executive search and staffing services. Headquartered in Houston, TX, the company has built a reputation for fostering strong relationships and delivering quality placements in the technology sector. With a team of 270 employees, Talent Group is a trusted partner for businesses seeking IT expertise.

Queen Consulting Group, based in Boston, is another award-winning IT staffing firm with over 30 years of experience. They leverage their extensive knowledge of the hiring process to match the right talent with the right companies. With a strong national presence, they have built a solid client base, making them a reliable choice for businesses across the US.

26. Epitec

Epitec is a leading IT staffing agency with over 45 years of experience, founded in 1978. Known for its rapid hiring process, the company provides staffing solutions in IT, engineering, and professional roles. With a team of around 1,250 employees, Epitec offers contract, contract-to-hire, and direct hire services across North America.

Headquartered in Southfield, MI, Epitec excels in staff augmentation, vendor management, and customized software solutions, catering to local, national, and international markets. Guided by their core value of “Placing People First,” Epitec continues to connect top talent with businesses effectively.

27. CSI Tech

CSI Tech is a staffing and technology solutions company with a strong partnership network, including several Fortune 500 companies. They have a proven track record of providing talent and workforce management services, maintaining a 99.5% client retention rate. With offices across the USA, CSI Tech has built a strong network to meet the diverse staffing needs of its clients.

Based in Keasbey, NJ, CSI Technology Group specializes in delivering complete technology solutions for public sector agencies, including state courts and police departments. With over 30 years of experience, they focus on providing premier software solutions for eGovernment. The company employs about 90 people and operates within the Internet Software & Services industry, using tools like Amazon SES, Microsoft Exchange Online, and Sybase.

28. Peyton Resource Group (PRG)

Peyton Resource Group (PRG), based in Irving, TX, is a leading staffing agency that specializes in providing permanent and flexible staffing solutions. They cater to various clients across Texas and nationwide, offering short-term, long-term, and permanent workforce solutions. Founded in 2001, PRG has built strong, lasting relationships with its clients, emphasizing the importance of finding the right talent to boost productivity and increase revenue.

With around 30 employees, PRG operates in the Professional Services industry and utilizes tools like Google Analytics, Microsoft Exchange Online, and Salesforce. They continue to deliver valuable human resource support to organizations and businesses.

29. 52 Limited

52 Limited, based in Portland, OR, is a creative and technology staffing agency specializing in connecting top talent with leading brands, marketing departments, design firms, and advertising agencies. Founded a decade ago, 52 Limited primarily works with startup companies, helping them enhance their chances of success by hiring skilled professionals from the outset.

The agency serves clients mainly in Seattle, San Francisco, and Portland, providing staffing and recruiting services for creative professionals. With a team of around 30 employees, 52 Limited operates within the Professional Services industry and uses tools like Google Analytics, Salesforce, and Microsoft Project to streamline their processes.

30. Lucas Group

Lucas Group, founded in 1970, is a staffing firm based in Chicago, Illinois, that specializes in connecting military professionals with civilian and corporate jobs after their retirement. With more than 50 years of experience, the firm is renowned for its work in Executive Search, professional staff search, and recruitment process outsourcing, with a particular focus on the IT sector.

Lucas Group is committed to fostering the growth of small businesses by offering operational practices and business development strategies that drive success. The firm operates in various industries, including manufacturing, marketing, and real estate, and uses technologies such as GoDaddy Nameserver, Google Apps, Typekit, and Squarespace to streamline their services.

31. Heinsohn Xelerator

Heinsohn is a Texas-based company specializing in Internet Software & Services, with a workforce of around 1,500 employees. They offer a wide range of IT solutions and use technologies like Google Tag Manager, Gravity Forms, LinkedIn Advertiser, WordPress, HubSpot, and reCAPTCHA. Heinsohn focuses on sectors such as e-commerce, computer programming, and professional IT services.

Heinsohn Xelerator, their nearshore IT staffing arm, offers access to a broad array of IT roles and technologies with the added benefit of global reach. They focus on customer satisfaction and can customize staffing models to meet specific needs.

Their services offer benefits such as lower operational costs, reduced recruitment stress, and access to top talent from Latin America, including experts in software development and DevOps engineering. Clients appreciate Heinsohn Xelerator’s professionalism and expertise, as reflected in their high client retention rates.

32. Han Staffing 

Han Staffing, based in Iselin, New Jersey, is an IT staffing company committed to diversity and social responsibility. They prioritize building a diverse workforce and have strong ties with minority-owned businesses. Known for their collaborative and inclusive approach, Han Staffing ensures that they match clients with the best talent from various backgrounds.

The company offers a range of staffing solutions, including contract, contract-to-hire, and direct-hire placements, with a focus on finding the right fit for both clients and candidates. With around 45 employees, Han Staffing operates in the Human Resource & Employment Services industry.

Conclusion

In conclusion, the best IT staffing companies in the USA offer a wide range of services to meet the diverse needs of businesses across industries. From large global firms to specialized agencies focusing on niche roles, these companies excel in connecting talented professionals with organizations looking for skilled IT experts.

Looking for an astrologer in Chandigarh usually starts with a specific worry — a stalled career, a marriage match, a new house, or a health scare in the family. The Tricity (Chandigarh, Mohali and Panchkula, with Zirakpur close by) has one of the densest clusters of practising astrologers in North India: multi-decade Vedic practitioners in the sector markets, Vastu specialists serving the region’s constant construction, and a newer generation working online and on tarot.

This guide shortlists 15 astrologers and astrology centres you can actually verify — every name below has a physical Chandigarh/Tricity presence or an official website, a stated area of practice, and a track record visible in public listings. We explain what each one is best for, so you can match the astrologer to your question instead of just picking the first name you see.

A note on expectations: astrology is a belief-based practice. Treat a consultation as guidance and perspective, be wary of anyone who guarantees outcomes or pressures you into expensive remedies, and never delay medical, legal or financial decisions because of a reading.

Quick Answer

FAQs

Who is the best astrologer in Chandigarh for kundali matching?

The Indian Institute of Astrology (Sector 27-C) and Vedang Vidya Bhawan (Sector 23-C) are the strongest traditional picks for methodical kundali matching; both are long-running Chandigarh addresses with matching as a core service.

How much does an astrologer in Chandigarh charge?

Fees vary widely — from a few hundred rupees for a short market-lane consultation to several thousand for detailed sessions with senior practitioners; Vastu site work is usually quoted per project. Always confirm the total fee, including any remedy costs, before the session starts.

Are online consultations with Chandigarh astrologers reliable?

Several practitioners on this list (for example Narinder Kataria and Vedic Astro Solutions) run official websites and take bookings online. Judge an online astrologer by the same tests as an offline one: fixed identity, stated fees, no guaranteed outcomes, no pressure selling.

Which astrologer is best in Mohali and Zirakpur?

In Mohali, Sahil Shastri (Sector 70) and Jyothish Samrat (Sector 59/Phase 4) lead on experience and ratings. In Zirakpur, Pt. Dr. Kumar Kaushish (Civil Lines) and AB Astro Life (Baltana) are the standout verified options.

Should I choose Vedic astrology, Vastu or tarot?

Vedic astrology for life-pattern and timing questions, Vastu when the question is about a home or commercial space, and tarot for a current situation you want to think through conversationally. Many Tricity clients combine a Vedic reading with a Vastu check before buying property.

Conclusion

Chandigarh’s astrology market rewards a little homework. The 15 names above were chosen because you can verify them — a real address, an official website, or a long public track record — and because each is genuinely best at something different, from the Indian Institute of Astrology’s traditional kundali work in Sector 27-C to Dr. Jasleen’s Vastu specialism in Sector 35-C and Avni’s tarot practice in Mohali. Shortlist two or three that match your question, confirm fees upfront, and treat the consultation as one input into your decision — not the decision itself.

title.rendered: Top 20 Event Management Companies in Hyderabad for Weddings, Corporate Events and Concerts

content.rendered:
Quick answer first, then the detailed list — 20 event management companies with a verified Hyderabad presence, for weddings, corporate events, conferences, concerts and exhibitions, each with a real photograph, its base or Hyderabad office, its specialisation, and what to check before you book.

Hyderabad runs two event economies at once. Around Madhapur and Gachibowli it is corporate India — product launches, offsites and some of Asia’s largest medical and scientific congresses at the Hyderabad International Convention Centre (HICC) and HITEX. Across the rest of the city it is celebration India — Telugu weddings, sangeets and receptions at palace hotels, banquet halls and lawns from Banjara Hills to Kompally. The best event management companies in Hyderabad usually specialise in one of these worlds, and this list tells you which is which.

Every company below has a real Hyderabad presence — a headquarters, a genuine office or substantial operations in the city — verified against its official website or a credible directory listing in October 2026. Experience figures and ratings are attributed to their sources (company websites, JustDial and published company profiles); we have not invented fees, phone numbers or review counts. Prices in this industry are quoted per event after a scope discussion, so any company that gives you a firm price without asking about venue, guest count and production needs is guessing. For the national picture, see our guide to the top event management companies in India.

Quick Answer: Which Hyderabad Event Company Should You Pick?

For a televised or stadium-scale production, start with Wizcraft International Entertainment, which keeps a Hyderabad office. For conferences and congresses at HICC or HITEX, start with KW Conferences or Hyderabad’s own Rachnoutsav Events and Traditions Event Management. For corporate events with showmanship, look at Event Uno and Eventina. For weddings, the shortlist splits by style: Alankaran and Yellow Planners for luxury, Vajra Events and EthniQ Events for large traditional celebrations, and strong neighbourhood firms such as Mukta Event Managers, Team Srishti Events, Susaadhya and Nishitha Events for family-scale budgets. For a ticketed public event, use MeraEvents; to assemble vendors yourself, use Event Needz; for a gated-community carnival, call Celestia Events.

How to Choose an Event Management Company in Hyderabad

Hyderabad has hundreds of organisers, and the difference between a smooth event and a stressful one is usually paperwork, not taste. Before you pay any advance:

  • Get the scope in writing. An itemised quote that separates venue, catering, décor, sound, lighting, artists, photography and management fee. Vague lump sums are where budgets leak.
  • Ask what is produced in-house. Firms with their own staging, fabrication, AV and décor teams (several on this list have them) recover faster when something changes on the day.
  • Check references for a similar event. A company brilliant at sangeets may be new to 2,000-delegate conferences. Ask for two clients with events like yours and actually call them.
  • Confirm permissions and licences. Concerts, outdoor events and liquor service in Hyderabad need police, excise and venue permissions; your contract should name who obtains them.
  • Pin the cancellation and postponement terms. Weather, artist dropout and venue issues happen. The refund ladder and date-shift policy belong in the agreement, not in a WhatsApp chat.
  • Fix the payment schedule. Tie payments to milestones (booking, production start, event day, closure) and list what is excluded — GST, venue charges, generator fuel and overtime are the usual surprises.
  • Name the event-day commander. One person with authority to spend and decide on the day, with a phone number that is answered.

Why clients shortlist them:

  • Verified listing, locality and tenure on JustDial
  • Corporate-district base
  • Décor capability for office celebrations and offsites

Also Worth Knowing

Venues decide the shortlist. For conventions, HICC (Novotel campus, Madhapur) and HITEX Exhibition Centre host the city’s largest events; KW Conferences keeps its Hyderabad office at HITEX itself. For weddings, Taj Falaknuma Palace is the marquee heritage venue — Event Uno states it has been a premier partner there since 2018 — while Banjara Hills and Jubilee Hills hotels, Gachibowli’s Financial District venues and Kompally’s lawns cover most other budgets. An organiser who works your venue regularly will know its load-in rules, power backup and sound limits.

Season matters. Wedding demand peaks from November to February and again in the summer muhurtham windows; corporate offsites cluster around quarter-ends. Book headline firms 4–6 months out for peak dates, and expect minimum-spend conditions at premium venues. Monsoon (June to September) makes lawn events risky — insist on a written rain plan.

Planning in another city too? Several firms here work beyond Hyderabad — EthniQ also covers Vijayawada and Visakhapatnam, and Yellow Planners covers Vijayawada. For the west coast, compare our list of the top event management companies in Mumbai, and for multi-city productions start from the India-wide directory.

FAQs

How much does an event management company in Hyderabad charge?

There is no honest standard rate card. Management fees are quoted per event after the scope is fixed, and total budgets swing with venue, guest count, catering and production. As a rule, the management fee is a small part of a budget dominated by venue and food. Get two or three itemised quotes for the same written scope and compare line by line — this article deliberately publishes no invented prices.

How far in advance should I book?

For peak wedding dates (November to February) and large conferences, 4–6 months is sensible and headline firms book out earlier. Corporate events with standard production can often be turned around in 4–8 weeks. Community and society events, Celestia’s speciality, usually need 6–10 weeks for permissions and stall bookings.

Can these companies book the venue for me?

Usually yes — most firms here will shortlist, negotiate and book venues as part of the scope, and some hold working relationships with specific venues (Event Uno with Taj Falaknuma Palace, for example). Make sure the venue contract and its cancellation terms are in your name, whoever negotiates them.

Do I need a Hyderabad-based company for a Hyderabad event?

For anything with staging, décor or permissions, a team with a real Hyderabad office or headquarters is a practical advantage: local vendor rates, venue familiarity and staff who can reach the site in an hour. National firms like Wizcraft qualify because they keep a Hyderabad office; a purely outstation firm should show you its local production partner in writing.

What should the contract cover?

The itemised scope and exclusions, the payment schedule tied to milestones, who obtains permissions and licences, the cancellation and postponement refund ladder, the rain or backup plan for outdoor formats, and the name of the event-day lead. If a company resists putting these in writing, that is your answer.

Conclusion

Hyderabad rewards specialists. Pick a conference organiser for a conference (KW Conferences, Rachnoutsav, Traditions), a wedding studio for a wedding (Alankaran, Yellow Planners, Vajra, EthniQ), a platform for a ticketed or self-planned event (MeraEvents, Event Needz), and a neighbourhood firm with hundreds of local reviews when budget and familiarity matter most (Team Srishti, Mukta, Susaadhya, Nishitha, Darsh). Whichever you choose, the checks are the same: written scope, similar-event references, in-house production where it counts, and cancellation terms on paper before the advance is paid.

Researched in October 2026 from the companies’ official websites and directory listings (JustDial, GoodFirms, ThreeBestRated, KnotsbyAMP and MCA records). Ratings and event counts are attributed to their sources and change over time — confirm current details with the company before booking.
